jobs.title: Program Coordinator, San Francisco
jobs.description:
**Program Coordinator, San Francisco** 

**Organization:** The Thriving Initiative **Location:** Hybrid (Approximately 75% remote, 25% in\-person)\| San Francisco, CA

**Employment Type:** Part\-Time **Hours:** 10\-15 hours per week **Compensation:** $20–$22 per hour

**Who We Are**

The Thriving Initiative is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit serving survivors on college campuses including San Francisco State University, San Diego State University, and UC Santa Barbara. Our programs are survivor\-centered, trauma\-informed, and grounded in deep respect for community healing.

We are a small but highly committed team. Every staff member is here because they believe in this work. We value innovation, empathy, community, and respect.

**Position Overview**

The Program Coordinator plays a vital role in the day\-to\-day program operations and community\-facing presence of The Thriving Initiative at San Francisco State University (SFSU) and in the broader San Francisco community. This role will support the planning and execution of events and workshops, build and nurture campus and community partnerships, and serve as an accessible point of contact for students seeking resources and connection. The ideal candidate is organized, empathetic, and passionate about improving the lives of survivors. This role reports to the Program Operations Manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program \& Event Support**

* Oversee and implement weekly in\-person healing and recovery workshops utilizing diverse alternative forms of healing
* Oversee logistics for events and workshops, including ordering and bringing physical workshop materials, setting up venues, and coordinating with service providers before, during, and after each event.
* Attend weekly staff meetings and a weekly one\-on\-one meeting with the Program Manager
* Works collaboratively with program team to ensure smooth program operations
* Attend and support both on\-campus and off\-campus planned events
* Assist with financial management related to events and workshops, including tracking expenditures and processing orders
* Oversee participant intake and attendance rosters for all sessions
* Assist with additional projects that are assigned

**Student Engagement**

* Directly coordinate all SFSU volunteer engagement activities and oversight.
* Hold regular weekly office hours to provide student volunteers with an accessible, welcoming space to connect, ask questions, and plan activities
* Plan and coordinate bonding activities for student officers to build community and team cohesion
* Draft communication and outreach templates to streamline student officer tasks and outreach efforts
* Empower the volunteer team to create safe, welcoming spaces where survivors feel seen and supported

**Program Outreach** 

* Collaborate with on\-campus partners in planning and delivering programming and events
* Support coordination of tabling events, campus involvement fairs, and promotional flyering across SFSU to drive event attendance
* Closely collaborate with Communications and Outreach coordinator to co\-lead weekly marketing meetings, ensure proper volunteer engagement, and appropriate content creation

**Partnership Development**

* Cultivate and maintain on\-campus partnerships with relevant university departments, student organizations, and offices
* Lead occasional local funding request opportunities
* Foster and strengthen relationships with community partners to expand The Thriving Initiative’s network of support and resources

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Commitment to supporting survivors of interpersonal violence and sexual assault
* Prior involvement in advocacy, social justice, mental health, or survivor support work
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Ability to work collaboratively with volunteers, staff, workshop participants, and community partners
* Comfort with basic financial tracking and administrative tasks
* Knowledge of San Francisco State University clubs, organizations, administration, etc.
* Reliable transportation to and from events
* Must be able to transport workshop materials to and from program sites in a timely manner, including loading and unloading supplies up to 25 pounds, reasonable accommodations can be made.

**Preferred**

* Experience in event planning, program coordination, or nonprofit work
* Experience working with or within campus communities
* Bachelors degree or equivalent work experience
* Trauma\-informed training will be provided, but previous mental health experience is a major plus

**Working Conditions**

This is a part\-time, hybrid position with in\-person requirements near San Francisco State University campus. Some off\-campus travel for events and community partnerships may be required. Hours may occasionally vary around events and workshops.

**Compensation \& Work Structure**

* **Pay rate:** $20–$22 per hour
* **Hours:** Approximately 15 hours per week

**Benefits**

* Flexible scheduling
* A highly collaborative, mission\-aligned team environment
* Meaningful professional development and growth opportunities
* The opportunity to contribute directly to survivor\-centered work that creates real change

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Program** **Coordinator**


**Location:** Hybrid; California\-based, with a strong preference for the San Francisco Bay Area  

**Status:** Full\-time, Exempt  

**Reports to:** Senior Program Manager


**Salary** Range: $58,839\-$88,259


**About the Center for Care Innovations**  

The Center for Care Innovations (CCI) is a nonprofit organization working to transform the health care safety net. Our mission is to spark, seed, and spread innovations that strengthen the health and wellbeing of historically underinvested communities.  

  

For more than 25 years, CCI has worked alongside safety net organizations to navigate a changing health care landscape, test new approaches, strengthen organizations and leaders, and help promising ideas spread across the field. Rooted in California, we partner with community health centers, public hospitals, community\-based organizations, managed care plans, public agencies, and philanthropy.  

  

Our work spans capacity\-building initiatives, advising and consulting, and ecosystem development: running intensive learning collaboratives and accelerators, providing tailored advising and research, and hosting cross\-sector gatherings. These bring people together to tackle some of the health care safety net's most pressing challenges.  

  

For more information, please see the www.careinnovations.org (http://www.careinnovations.org/).
  

  

**About the Program Coordinator Role**


CCI is looking for a collaborative, proactive, and organized Program Coordinator to support initiatives that help health care safety net organizations improve care and advance health equity. This is a great role for someone who has experience supporting complex initiatives and enjoys keeping many moving pieces organized, anticipating what different stakeholders need, and creating a thoughtful experience for participants and partners.  

  

You'll work across multiple CCI initiatives and team configurations, building your experience in project management, health systems improvement, events and learning experiences, and partner engagement. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work while thriving as part of a collaborative, matrixed team.  

  

**What** **You'll Do**


* **Keep multiple initiatives organized and moving forward.** Coordinate day\-to\-day activities across multiple initiatives, tracking tasks, timelines, milestones, and deliverables. Maintain work plans and knowledge management systems, anticipate needs, and help ensure important details don't fall through the cracks.


* **Coordinate meetings and keep teams connected.** Manage scheduling, prepare agendas, presentations, reports, participant resources, and other materials, take notes, and document and track action items across internal and external meetings.


* **Create seamless and welcoming participant experiences.** Serve as a responsive point of contact for participants and partners, anticipate their needs, communicate clearly and warmly, and troubleshoot issues throughout CCI initiatives.


* **Coordinate high\-quality in\-person and virtual events.** Partner to plan and host highly interactive convenings, workshops, conferences, and other learning experiences. Coordinate venues, vendors, registration, participant communications, speakers, materials, on\-site logistics, and virtual platforms such as Zoom.


* **Support communications and learning materials.** Draft participant communications, newsletters, presentations, and other resources, and coordinate with CCI colleagues on initiative webpages, external communications, and learning materials.


* **Use data to support learning and improvement.** Maintain accurate participant and engagement data, including attendance, satisfaction surveys, and other initiative information in Salesforce and CCI's other tracking systems. Gather and synthesize participant feedback, prepare reports and summaries, and help teams identify trends, successes, and opportunities for improvement.


* **Support grants, contracts, and initiative finances.** Track deliverables, contracts, invoices, expenses, and related documentation in partnership with initiative leads.


**You Might Be a Great Fit If You...**


* Have at least three years of relevant experience supporting or coordinating complex initiatives, ideally in health care, public health, nonprofit, community\-based, or related settings.


* Have a bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


* Have experience supporting multiple initiatives simultaneously and using work plans, timelines, task tracking, and other tools to keep complex work moving forward.


* Are self\-motivated and organized, with strong time\-management skills and the ability to manage changing priorities independently while collaborating effectively with a team.


* Have experience planning and hosting in\-person events, convenings, or other complex gatherings.


* Bring a strong participant, partner, or customer\-service orientation and enjoy making sure people feel welcomed, informed, and well supported.


* Are a clear and thoughtful communicator who can develop polished emails, presentations, meeting materials, participant resources, and other communications for different audiences.


* Bring some familiarity with California's health care safety net ecosystem actors (i.e Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), Medi\-Cal Managed Care Plans (MCPs) and key reforms (i.e. CalAIM) and are interested in continuing to deepen that knowledge.

* Are comfortable working with data and spreadsheets and can maintain accurate information, identify basic trends, and turn data and feedback into useful summaries.

jobs.title: Medical Field Case Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. **Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**
Job Description:
**This is a full\-time, hybrid position. The candidate must be located in the San Jose, CA area due to regular local travel for in\-person patient appointments.** **Perks:** Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, mileage and travel reimbursement, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands\-on workers’ compensation case management training.  

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Field Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost\-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:* Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
* Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
* Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non\-occupational.
* Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
* Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
* Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
* Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
* Complete other duties, such as attend injured worker’s appointments when appropriate, prepare status updates for submittal to customers, and other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:
* **Education:** Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
* **Experience:** 2\+ years clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation\-related experience preferred.
* **Skills:** Ability to advocate recommendations effectively with physicians/providers, employers, and customers. Ability to work independently. Knowledge of basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and Outlook Email. Proficient grammar, sentence structure, and written communication skills.
* **Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:**
	+ Active Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Must be in good standing.
	+ URAC\-recognized certification in case management (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN\-S, RN\-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC).
* **Travel:** Must have reliable transportation and be able to travel to and attend in\-person appointments with injured workers in assigned geography.
* **Internet:** Must have reliable internet.
* **Transportation:** Must have reliable transportation and be able to travel to and attend in\-person appointments with injured workers in assigned geography.


Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well\-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD\&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full\-time or part\-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $100,000 \- $105,000 annually. In addition to the base salary, you will be eligible to participate in our productivity\-based bonus program. Your total compensation, including base pay and potential bonus, will be based on a number of factors including skills, experience, education, and performance metrics.

jobs.title: Patient Access Coordinator
jobs.description:
Why Us?:

With a mantra of Empowering Human Potential, Hanger, Inc. is the world's premier provider of orthotic and prosthetic (O\&P) services and products, offering the most advanced O\&P solutions, clinically differentiated programs and unsurpassed customer service. Hanger's Patient Care segment is the largest owner and operator of O\&P patient care clinics nationwide. Through its Products \& Services segment, Hanger distributes branded and private label O\&P devices, products and components, and provides rehabilitative solutions to the broader market. With 160 years of clinical excellence and innovation, Hanger's vision is to lead the orthotic and prosthetic markets by providing superior patient care, outcomes, services and value. Collectively, Hanger employees touch thousands of lives each day, helping people achieve new levels of mobility and freedom.
Could This Be For You?:

In this role, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring a seamless experience for patients, staff, and referral sources by managing front office operations efficiently. The ideal candidate will have a background in front desk or reception work with strong communication skills and computer proficiency.
Your Impact:
* **Patient Reception:** Greet and assist patients upon arrival, providing information on wait times and addressing inquiries at the front desk or reception area
* **Patient Intake:** Verify and update patient demographics and insurance details during check\-in; handle walk\-in registrations
* **Financial Transactions:** Collect patient payments, including deductibles, copays, and co\-insurance at the front desk
* **Appointment Scheduling:** Coordinate follow\-up appointments, including cast and measure, delivery, and prosthetic care plans.
* **Patient Support:** Serve as a liaison for clinic services, offering information on patient experience programs, support groups, and other resources.
* **Administrative Assistance:** Collaborate with the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team to obtain necessary patient information.
* **Record Maintenance:** Ensure accurate and complete electronic health records for all patients.


Minimum Qualifications:
* High school diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Be at minimum a good fit for the job, as determined by the Talent Sorter assessment preferred. Hanger will administer the Talent Sorter as part of the selection process
* Less than one year of customer service, administrative or related experience required.
* Experience in a receptionist position or experience with medical front office procedures preferred.
* Must have, or be eligible to obtain, a valid driver’s license and driving record within the standards outlined within Hanger’s Motor Vehicle Safety Policy and Procedures.


Additional Success Factors:
* Strong interpersonal, oral (including telephone) and written communication skills.
* Ability to key 30 words per minute with accuracy required.
* Ability to work with handicapped individuals.
* Understanding of Alpha filing system.
* Understanding of medical reimbursement and terminology and an understanding of front office (receptionist) duties preferred.
* Ability to use a computer, including Windows\-based software and e\-mail.
* Ability to use all necessary office equipment, facsimile machines, calculator, postage machine, copier, etc.
* Act with integrity in all ways and at all times, remaining honest, transparent, and respectful in all relationships.
* Keep the patient at the center of everything that you do, building lifelong trust.
* Foster open collaboration and constructive dialogue with everyone around you.
* Continuously innovate new solutions, influencing and responding to change.
* Focus on superior outcomes, and calibrate work processes for outstanding results.  

  

(California State Only) Pay range of $24\.00\- $27\.00/hour \+ bonus \+ benefits. This pay range is posted to comply with State Law. Hanger salary ranges vary based on skill, ability, knowledge, geographic location and other variables.


Our Investment in You:
* Competitive Compensation Packages
* 8 Paid National Holidays \& 4 additional Floating Holidays
* PTO that includes Vacation and Sick time
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
* 401k Savings and Retirement Plan
* Paid Parental Bonding Leave for New Parents
* Generous Employee Referral Bonus Program
* Mentorship Programs\- Mentor and Mentee

jobs.title: Operations Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Overview:

TransitAmerica Services, Inc. is currently seeking an **Operations Training Specialist** in **San Jose, CA** to join our team.  

The pay range for this position is $130,000\.00 \-145,000\.00 annually.  

**Duties and Responsibilities:*** This is a non\-exhaustive overview of the job duties for this position.
* Develop, schedule, and deliver training programs for Operations employees, including new hire onboarding, annual rules training, company culture initiatives (R\-Factor), and regulatory compliance training.
* Maintain training records, monitor employee training completion, and collaborate with department leadership to develop training plans that support operational needs.
* Participate in 49 CFR Part 217 efficiency testing activities, including required joint testing and testing conducted with FRA, CPUC, and other regulatory agencies.
* Implement TASI standards, rules, and processes in response to regulatory requirements, including FRA Safety Advisories, and corrective actions resulting from internal investigations.
* Update and enhance training materials based on operational trends, incidents, regulatory changes, and business requirements to improve employee knowledge and performance.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and implement improvements through assessments, feedback, and collaboration with subject matter experts.
* Develop and coach trainers and employees involved in training efforts to promote continuous learning and professional development.
* Support safety initiatives by promoting consistent safety messaging, assisting with incident investigations, and implementing corrective actions and regulatory requirements.
* Participate in efficiency testing, audits, and field observations to ensure compliance, operational excellence, and quality service delivery.
* Maintain strong working relationships with department leaders to identify training needs and support continuous improvement efforts.
* Document and report training, testing, and audit results accurately and in a timely manner.
* Provide hands\-on instruction and leadership in the field while fostering a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work outside in all weather conditions and harsh environments.
* Availability to be on call in the evenings and weekends on a rotating basis.
* Regular and consistent engagement, participation and promotion of Herzog’s Culture and its essential behaviors are a requirement for this position.
* Regular and predictable attendance and punctuality are a requirement for this position.
* Other duties as assigned.

 **Qualifications:*** High school diploma or equivalent.
* An associate’s degree in education, business, or closely related field (can be substituted with 3 years passenger railroad experience)
* Licensed Locomotive Engineer or Conductor.
* Five years of experience in rail equipment operating industry, with at least two years in passenger service on electrified territory.
* Experience in education, training, and/or mentoring peers, preferably in a commuter rail environment.
* Knowledge of Federal Railroad Administration (FRA), California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC), California Occupational Health and Safety Administration (Cal/OSHA) rules and regulations.
* Knowledge of standard railroad rules and operating practices. Knowledge of General Code of Operating Rules (GCOR) is preferred.
* Knowledge of American Public Transportation Association standards.

 **Pre\-Employment Requirements:*** Subject to pre\-employment background check and motor vehicle report review.
* Maintain a valid driver’s license and endorsements as required per position.
* Subject to pre\-employment physical, medical evaluation, and drug screen due to the safety sensitive nature of this position.
* Successfully complete and maintain any required safety certification and testing on an annual basis.

  

**Physical Requirements:**
The physical demands described below must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential job functions of this role. This is a non\-exhaustive overview of the physical requirements of this job.* Perform light work, occasionally exerting up to 20 pounds of force.
* Able to walk on uneven surfaces.
* Occasionally ascend/descend step ladders and/or stairs.
* Regularly sit and stand for an extended period of time.
* Regularly kneel, bend, and squat.
* Must successfully pass color/vision examinations as required by the position.
* Must be able to hear and distinguish auditory signals.
* Able to work in conditions with loud noise; work on/around heavy/moving machinery.
* Able to work outdoors in all weather conditions (hot, cold, rain, snow, and sleet).

 **Safety:*** Herzog is nationally recognized for its excellent corporate safety record which results from all employees at all levels, in all positions adhering to established policies and procedures. Reporting any and all safety violations to your immediate supervisor is a prerequisite for continued employment. Safety diligence by all results in a safe work environment for all.

 **Benefits:*** Herzog offers a robust benefits package including medical and dental coverage. The plans are specific to projects and locations.

jobs.title: Staff Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Staff Product Operations Manager**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a **Staff** **Product Operations Manager** to build and operate the processes that connect product strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and portfolio decision\-making across a multi\-product R\&D organization.


This role will partner closely with Product Management, R\&D Operations, Program Management, Engineering, and Finance to create a consistent and scalable approach for product management and R\&D priorities.


The Staff Product Operations Manager will provide the structure, analytics, and governance needed to help leadership make informed tradeoffs across products while enabling Product Managers to remain focused on customers, markets, product strategy, and product outcomes.  



**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with Product Managers to create governance around product strategies, value propositions, target markets, and strategic objectives
* Integrate individual product strategies and roadmaps into a consolidated enterprise product portfolio view.
* Develop clear executive\-level views of priorities, roadmap changes, portfolio performance, dependencies, tradeoffs and coordinate regular product portfolio reviews.
* Facilitate cross\-product prioritization and develop tradeoff scenarios for leadership.
* Partner with R\&D Program Management and Engineering to identify capacity and resource conflicts created by product priorities.
* Incorporate financial analysis, ROI, NPV, sensitivity analysis, and investment requirements into portfolio decisions. Ensure product, commercial, engineering, financial, and execution inputs are available for major portfolio decisions.
* Establish common product and portfolio KPI standards.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering or related field; MBA preferred but not required.
* 12\+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Operations or related functions.
* Experience working in global complex product\-development environments; hardware, industrial technology, or engineering\-intensive industries preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with product roadmaps, portfolio prioritization, business cases, and executive governance.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to structure complex portfolio decisions and tradeoffs.
* Experience developing scalable processes, dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting.
* Strong cross\-functional leadership and communication skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Ability to translate between product, engineering, financial, and executive stakeholders.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A clear and integrated enterprise view of product strategy and roadmaps.
* Consistent prioritization and business\-case standards across product teams.
* Leadership has clear visibility into portfolio tradeoffs before making investment and resource decisions.
* Product demand is translated into clear, prioritized inputs for R\&D portfolio planning.
* Resource and roadmap conflicts are identified earlier.

jobs.title: Operations Manager - Asset Services
jobs.description:
Kidder Mathews of California has been a leader in the commercial real estate industry for over 10 years, fostering an innovative and dynamic work culture with more than 100 "best workplace" awards. Kidder Mathews of California has over 350 professionals across 11 offices in California. We offer a complete range of brokerage, appraisal, asset services, consulting, and debt \& equity finance services for all property types. The firm averages $9 billion in transaction volume, manages more than 58 million square feet of space, and conducts 2,400 appraisal, consulting, and cost segregation assignments annually. Join us and find out what makes Kidder Mathews of California one of the best places to work.
  
  

JOB SUMMARY
  
The Operations Manager is responsible for the day\-to\-day oversight and coordination of all aspects of on\-going maintenance demands of the Portfolio. The Operations Manager will ensure that the Kidder Mathews Team reflects the highest level of professionalism in all aspects of the maintenance operations of the Portfolio, with focus on the goals and objectives of the Client, and the mission of Kidder Mathews Asset Services Division. In addition, the Operations Manager will provide the leadership necessary to meet all Portfolio maintenance, capital improvement projects and “Show Ready” requirements, including timely response to and resolution of any tenant or owner requests or concerns.
  
  

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  
  

**Property Operations:**  

* Perform or direct to be performed, monthly physical property inspections, scheduled preventive maintenance work, reactive repairs, and special projects as directed and approved by the client
* Create the project scope and ensure follow through on any needed repairs or maintenance, whether performed by vendors, contractors or KM staff
* Interface with tenants, property vendors, and contractors to ensure prompt response to maintenance issues
* Ensure on\-going contracted vendor services are performed on schedule, that services meet contract specifications and are performed in accordance with an approved operating budget
* Partner with vendors to increase value and implement long term cost savings
* Review specifications and makes recommendations to Senior Property Manager, as appropriate, for necessary changes or updates.
* Prepare specifications, requests/reviews/compares and recommends bids for contracted services
* Partner with Kidder Mathews staff and contracted maintenance personnel to schedule repairs and create work orders
* Interface with client on property operational issues
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance the value of the asset and to implement long term cost savings
* In partnership with the Engineering Team, develop and implement preventive maintenance program for the Portfolio: review preventive maintenance reports and schedule needed repairs
* Note items on inspection checklist which require additional follow up and follow up in a timely manner
* Participate in regular KM staff meetings
* Participate in regular safety trainings
* Create work schedule for other Engineering Team members
* Participate in periodic property tours or meetings with client
* Ensure and maintain quality appearance of property meeting both client and KM standards
* Perform and track energy benchmarking on all buildings in portfolio


**Financial and Reporting:**  

* Participate in annual budgeting process including re\-bid of service contracts and bids for planned capital expenditures
* Draft operations narrative for monthly owner operating report


**Tenant and Owner Relations:**  

* Maintain courteous, service\-oriented rapport with Tenants
* Manage communication flow with tenants impacted by construction or scheduled repair work
* Promote and foster confident, comfortable relationships with Tenants and Clients
* Supervise all “Adds/Moves/Changes of work” areas in the building
* Partner with Client Safety committee to create employee emergency procedures manual for new assignments


**Tenant Move In/Out and Construction:**  

* Conduct (with tenant) tenant move\-in inspections; complete move\-in inspection report
* Conduct pre\-move out inspections with tenants a minimum of 30 days prior to termination of lease
* Conduct (with tenant) tenant move out inspections
* Collect all preventative maintenance reports to ensure that all tenant\-maintained equipment has been appropriately maintained and is being surrendered in good working condition
* Create “show ready” scope in accordance with the client’s specifications to get vacant space into “show ready” condition
* Schedule and manage vendor/contractor work on all vacant spaces
* Prepare specification and bid tenant improvement construction
* Review/recommend tenant improvement construction bids
* Attend construction meetings; provide input and/or feedback as needed
* Partner with construction contractor to ensure schedules are met and improvements are performed in accordance with client and new tenant requirements and building standards as well as ensuring that other tenants are not inconvenienced during any period of construction activity
* Conduct walk throughs, as needed, with contractor(s) during construction process
* Perform final punch list and ensure all punch list items are corrected
* Maintains construction file


OTHER FUNCTIONS
  
* Perform other duties or projects as requested or required


ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the competencies (minimum knowledge, skill, and ability) required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  

SKILLS AND ABILITY
  
* Ability to work with minimal supervision and lead by example
* Strong computer skills (MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)
* Demonstrated ability to read and understand construction dra

jobs.title: Operations Manager - Sonesta Select Oyster Point San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
**Join our team!**


At Sonesta Oyster Point San Francisco, we are committed to delivering exceptional guest experiences through outstanding service, operational excellence, and a culture of hospitality. We are seeking an experience and motived Operational Manager to oversee our Housekeeping and Maintenance operations while supporting the General Manager in driving overall hotel performance.


This leadership position is responsible for ensuring the hotel's physical condition, cleanliness, safety, and operational readiness. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on leader who thrives in a fast\-paced hospitality environment and is passionate about team development, asset protection, and operational efficiency.

**Position Summary**


The operational Manager oversees the daily operations of the Housekeeping and Maintenance departments, ensuring the hotel maintains the highest standards of cleanliness, safety, and functionality, This role is responsible for protecting hotel assets through preventive maintenance, leading high performing teams, and supporting guest satisfaction initiatives.


The Operations Manager champions WS Management's commitment to Outrageous Hospitality, core values, and the three P Philosophy:

**People:** Support and develop team members through effective leadership and coaching.

**Planet:** Promote sustainable and efficient operational practices

**Profit:** Protect hotel assets and optimize labor and operational expenses.


This position serves as a Manager\-On\-Duty and may act as the General Manager's representative when necessary.

**Key responsibilities**

**Housekeeping LeadershipQuality Assurance**

Oversee daily housekeeping operations, room readiness, inspections, and cleaning standards.


Ensure all guest rooms, public areas, and back\-of\-house spaces meet or exceed brand standards


Manage scheduling staffing levels, training, coaching, and performance management for Housekeeping team members.


Partner closely with Front Desk leadership to ensure room status accuracy and efficient room turnover.


Conduct regular quality inspections and implement corrective action plans when neccessary.

**MaintenanceAsset Management**


Lead preventative maintenance programs and ensure timely completion of work orders.


Maintain building systems including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and life\-safety equipment


Perform regular property inspections to identify maintenance, safety, and appearance concerns.


Coordinate vender services, repairs, and approval capital improvement projects


Protect hotel assets through proactive maintenance and repair planning

**Safety, ComplianceRisk Mangement**


Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, company policies, and fire\-life\-safety standards


Oversee proper chemical handling, MSDS compliance, and equipment safety procedures,


Maintain accurate inspection records, logs, and compliance documentation


Respond professionally and effectively to emergencies and operational incidents


Promote a culture of workplace safety and accountability

**Qualifications**


Minimum 3 years of hotel operations, housekeeping, maintenance, or facilities management leadership experience


Proven experience leading and developing teams in a hospitality environment


Strong understanding of hotel operations, cleanliness standards, and preventative maintenance programs.


Working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and general building systems


Experience managing labor costs, departmental budgets, and inventory controls


Strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills


Proficiency with hotel property management systems and Microsoft Office applications


Ability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.


This statement listed are intended to represent the key duties and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be all responsibilities or qualifications of the job. Due to the cyclical nature of the hospitality industry, employees may be required to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs of the hotel. We are an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and make employment decisions without regard to age, race, religion, national origin, gender, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or other protected class. Those who are ineligible to work in the United States will not be considered.

jobs.title: Operations Manager | MCA – Real Estate Brokerage
jobs.description:
Operations Manager / MCA – Real Estate Brokerage

**Keller Williams Bay Area Estates \| Los Gatos, CA**  
**$90,000–$120,000 Base Salary \+ Performance Bonus**  
**Full\-Time \| In Person**

Lead Operations for One of Silicon Valley’s Top Luxury Real Estate Brokerages

Keller Williams Bay Area Estates (KWBAE) is the **\#1 most profitable Keller Williams real estate brokerage year\-to\-date in the Northern California \& Hawaii Region** and one of Silicon Valley’s leading luxury real estate brokerages.

We are looking for an experienced operational leader who wants to make a meaningful impact on a successful, growing organization.

About the Position

We are seeking a hands\-on **Operations Manager / Market Center Administrator (MCA)** to join our brokerage leadership team and help drive sustainable growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

This role oversees financial and operational systems, leads onsite and virtual staff, and partners closely with senior and executive leadership on budgeting, forecasting, profitability, strategic planning, business development, sponsorships, and company\-wide growth initiatives.

You will help turn growth goals into actionable plans with clear priorities, owners, timelines, and measurements. You will monitor revenue, expenses, margins, cash flow, and key performance indicators while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen accountability, and increase profitability.

You will also help ensure the company has the people, systems, processes, training, and operational capacity needed to grow successfully. This includes supporting agent recruiting and retention, improving the agent and staff experience, strengthening internal systems, coordinating strategic initiatives, and helping leadership evaluate new opportunities.

This is not a traditional office manager or behind\-the\-desk administrative role. We need a proactive, numbers\-driven leader who understands how daily operations affect the bottom line, recognizes what needs to be done, proposes practical solutions, delegates effectively, and follows through until the work is completed correctly.

You will establish expectations, assign ownership, monitor performance, and ensure the operation performs at a high level. You will provide the financial and operational analysis leadership needs to make informed decisions about investments, staffing, programs, partnerships, and growth opportunities.

You are not expected to do everything yourself—but you are expected to own the outcome and be willing to personally help the team get the job done when needed.

What You’ll LeadPeople, Operations, and Accountability

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable onsite and virtual staff
* Establish clear priorities, responsibilities, deadlines, and performance standards
* Delegate effectively, monitor results, and ensure work is completed accurately and on time
* Coach team members, provide feedback, and address performance issues directly
* Coordinate vendors, contractors, consultants, and outside service providers
* Build productive relationships with independent agents and high\-producing real estate professionals
* Lead through influence as well as direct authority
* Anticipate and resolve problems with urgency, diplomacy, and sound judgment
* Step in personally when business or staffing needs require it

**Financial Management and Profitability**

* Participate in budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and business planning
* Monitor revenue, expenses, margins, cash flow, profitability, and key performance indicators
* Oversee key operational financial functions and reporting, including commissions, caps, accounts receivable, and accounts payable
* Ensure financial and operational reporting is accurate, complete, and timely
* Investigate discrepancies and ensure issues are resolved
* Identify inefficiencies, unnecessary expenses, and opportunities to improve profitability
* Provide analysis and recommendations that support executive decision\-making
* Help ensure the brokerage remains profitable and financially disciplined as it grows

**Systems, Technology, and Execution**

We need a **builder and implementer—not someone who only maintains existing systems.**

* Turn executive priorities into actionable plans with clear owners, deadlines, and measurements
* Own the implementation, adoption, and ongoing use of **Trainual**
* Build and maintain SOPs, training materials, workflows, and backup coverage
* Use **Todoist** to manage projects, responsibilities, deadlines, and accountability
* Lead new systems and processes from setup through rollout, training, adoption, and follow\-through
* Use technology, automation, and AI to improve efficiency and scalability
* Ensure initiatives are implemented and used—not simply discussed

**Executive Leadership and Growth**

* Serve as a trusted operational partner to senior and executive leadership
* Participate in company planning, operational strategy, and growth initiatives
* Support agent recruiting, retention, engagement, and production programs
* Ensure the company has the staffing, systems, training, and operational capacity required for growth
* Track company goals and provide clear progress reporting
* Identify operational obstacles and bring forward practical solutions
* Support business\-development initiatives, strategic partnerships, and sponsorship opportunities
* Help leadership evaluate new programs, investments, partnerships, and growth opportunities

**Luxury Office and Agent Experience**

* Ensure our office consistently reflects the standards of a top luxury real estate brokerage
* Evaluate the environment through the eyes of agents, recruits, clients, and guests
* Maintain high standards for presentation, organization, service, and professionalism
* Proactively identify and correct office issues before leadership needs to point them out
* Delegate office\-readiness responsibilities and verify completion
* Recommend and implement

jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
The Staff Program Manager, Sales Motion and Operations is responsible for Tesla’s end\-to\-end vehicle sales process across the Americas — including in\-store sales strategy, pipeline management, demo drive growth and pre\-owned sales enablement. You will define the process that takes a customer from interest to order, while improving order conversion, advisor productivity, and order experience across sales channels.


This role sits on the Americas Sales \& Delivery Operations team alongside peers who own sales systems, communications tools, self\-serve growth, and field support. You will be responsible for evolving operating standards, partnering with sales systems and IT to build the right tools, and working closely with Leadership \& Development to develop sales training content.

 **What You'll Do*** Own end\-to\-end sales motion strategy across lead capture, engagement, demo drives, follow\-up, and order conversion — including operating standards and sales motion fundamentals needed for in\-store operations
* Own the sales pipeline including stage definitions, contact cadence, conversion metrics, velocity metrics and health metrics that give leadership a clear view of funnel performance
* Lead pre\-owned sales enablement including process, tool and ongoing support needed to sell on\-site pre\-owned inventory confidently
* Develop scalable sales pilot programs and assess performance ahead of broader implementation
* Integrate customer and advisor and customer feedback to improve processes, training, and IT roadmaps
* Gain alignment across Sales leadership, field operations, L\&D, and IT; present data\-backed recommendations and ongoing status updates to senior leadership
  

**What You'll Bring*** Bachelor’s degree in business, Operations, Engineering, Economics, or equivalent experience
* 7\+ years in program management, sales operations, revenue operations, or a related field
* Experience owning end\-to\-end sales processes or go\-to\-market operations with in a high\-growth or complex industry, ideally in high\-volume retail, automotive, or complex B2C environments
* Experience with pipeline management, funnel diagnostics, and operational KPIs; advanced Excel required; SQL and BI tools preferred
* Experience using the latest AI tools to streamline workflows and support business decisions
* Ability to drive cross\-functional change without direct authority across field ops, training, and technology partners; experience with change management and field adoption a plus
#### **Benefits**

  

Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:


* Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits

* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
  
  

#### **Expected Compensation**


$108,000 \- $198,000/annual salary \+ cash and stock awards \+ benefits

jobs.description:
**Overview**


Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.


The American Heart Association has a phenomenal opportunity for an **Operations Manager, Government Grants** with our Office of Funded Programs (OFP) Team.


This is a full time, benefits eligible, grant funded opportunity. Current funding will expire on July 31, 2027, with the potential of extension. The location for this position can be flexible and home\-based.


Reporting to the National Government Funding Director, the Operations Manager, Government Grants will provide project\- and initiative\-level operational coordination and support to the Principal Investigators (PIs) and implementation teams for specific government grants throughout the grant lifecycle.


The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work\-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award\-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.


\#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work\-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.


**Responsibilities**


* **Expense Review** : Partner with project leads to ensure expenses and invoices are accurately completed, reviewed, approved, and submitted promptly.


* **Prior Approval Requests \& Compliance** : Identify project activities that may require prior approval or a waiver under the specific award terms, coordinate with Finance, Legal, or OFP partner to confirm requirements, and support preparation, routing, and tracking of related documentation.


* **Budget Planning and Monitoring** : Support project budget planning, monitoring, and forecasting to align resources with project needs, funding requirements, and federal cost principles. Coordinate budget revision requests, draft supporting justifications, track approvals, and partner with the appropriate finance teams on formal budget adjustments.


* **Personnel and Compensation Documentation** : Support review of personnel allocations, salary distribution documentation, and effort\-related materials to help ensure charges are aligned with approved project activities and available supporting documentation, in partnership with Finance, HR, and OFP.


* **Subrecipient and Contractor Coordination** : Coordinate operational documentation for contractors and subrecipients, support completion of required forms, track approvals in applicable systems, collect deliverable (e.g., Optimus) and invoice support, and assist with subrecipient monitoring activities.


* **Communication, Reporting, and Deliverable Tracking** : Draft or compile responses for internal review and approval, maintain project\-level communication logs, and collaborate with program teams to track milestones, deliverables, reporting requirements, and related follow\-up actions.


* **Cost Transfers and Expense Reallocations** : Support documentation, routing, and tracking of cost transfer or expense reallocation requests; confirm that required approvals are obtained; and escalate allowability, timeliness, or documentation questions to Finance or OFP.


* **Records Management and Closeout Support** : Maintain organized, audit\-ready project files, including approvals, communications, deliverable evidence, invoices, budget documentation, and closeout materials; support final documentation reconciliation, records retention, and project closeout activities.


* **Other Duties** : Perform other duties and projects, as assigned.

jobs.description:

San Francisco


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


On\-site


**Department**
--------------


Product


  
**About EliseAI**


At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.
  

  

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.


* **Housing**: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.
* **Healthcare**: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $250 million Series E round led by Andreessen Horowitz to accelerate this mission.


**About The Role**


EliseAI is rapidly expanding into new product lines serving large, sophisticated customers, and we are investing heavily in how those products are built, launched, and scaled.


The Product Operations Manager plays a central role in shaping this next phase of growth. You will work at the heart of product development, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to turn ambitious ideas into reliable, enterprise\-ready solutions. This role offers meaningful ownership over execution, launch quality, and iteration speed as we scale a fast\-growing business line.


You will operate close to both the product surface area and the underlying data, using technical and analytical skills to improve quality, adoption, and speed.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Translate product requirements into clear, buildable workflows through specs, diagrams, and edge\-case definition
* Conduct thorough discovery sessions with new clients to understand their needs and requirements
* Drive launch readiness and coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders through release
* Own enterprise implementation readiness, including migrations, permissions, templates, and configurations
* Lead post\-launch follow\-through to ensure issues are identified, resolved, and learned from
* Own feedback loop conversations, synthesizing data across multiple channels such as call snippets, Datadog, support tickets, surveys, and more—acting as the Voice of the Customer to drive short\- and long\-term improvements
* Build and scale product operations processes, including monitoring, issue resolution, and ongoing support operations
* Manage product compliance requirements and collaborate with Legal on regulatory or policy\-related initiatives
* Attract top\-tier talent to join our driven team

**Move at rocket speed, build something massive.**


We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.


We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.


**Requirements**


* Experience in product operations, management consulting, or related operational roles in high\-growth tech companies
* Proven ability to manage complex, cross\-functional initiatives in ambiguous environments
* Strong written communication skills, including specs and process documentation
* High attention to detail with strong ownership and follow\-through
* Willingness to work in person at our office 4\-5 days a week

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:


* Equity in the company
* Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%
* Fully paid parental leave

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About the job**
-----------------



The Sales Operations Manager serves as the day\-to\-day execution partner to the Head of Sales Operations, translating commercial priorities into reliable systems, data, workflows, and cross\-functional execution across every sales channel (DTC, wholesale, corporate/customization, marketplaces, and key accounts).



The right candidate combines systems aptitude with strong operational judgment. They are comfortable moving between supporting an ERP implementation, a fulfillment exception, a product\-launch checklist, a ticketing automation, a pricing audit, and trade\-show logistics—while maintaining accuracy, ownership, and follow\-through.



As part of a lean, growing company, this role also includes hands\-on administrative and coordination responsibilities. The successful candidate must be comfortable balancing strategic projects and systems work with the detailed day\-to\-day tasks required to keep operations organized and moving forward.


**What you'll own**
-------------------


* **Systems Administration \& Tech Stack:** Oversee day\-to\-day administration, integrations, and performance for ERP, Shopify, 3PL platforms, customer service tools, marketplaces, and reporting systems.
* **Technical Requirements \& Testing:** Translate business needs into user stories, process maps, and data mappings. Lead user acceptance testing (UAT), defect tracking, and release readiness with developers and vendors.
* **Troubleshooting \& Documentation:** Investigate workflow and data failures to resolution while maintaining comprehensive integration maps and SOPs.
* **Omnichannel Data Governance:** Manage SKU setup, product attributes, pricing, tags, and fulfillment logic across all channels to ensure cross\-platform data integrity.
* **GTM \& Launch Orchestration:** Act as operational liaison for go\-to\-market execution, aligning cross\-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Fulfillment) on timelines, dependencies, and launch readiness.
* **Sales \& Channel Enablement:** Equip sales reps and external retail partners with price sheets, collateral, samples, assets, and product data.
* **Fulfillment \& Warehouse Operations:** Coordinate daily operations with 3PLs and warehouses, actively tracking aging orders, inventory discrepancies, transfers, and shipping exceptions.
* **Customer Experience Optimization:** Administer CS ticketing systems, live chat, routing rules, and automated workflows.
* **Trade Show \& Event Logistics:** Support full\-scope event operations with the Sales Director, including booth service orders, budget tracking, freight delivery, material handling, and storage.

**The experience you'll bring**
-------------------------------


#### **Required:**


* 4\+ years of progressive experience in sales operations, business systems, fulfillment operations, or a comparable cross\-functional role.
* Demonstrated experience supporting business\-software implementations, integrations, migrations, or major workflow changes.
* Ability to communicate effectively with developers, implementation consultants, and software vendors to translate technical details into business impact.
* Working knowledge of omnichannel order management, fulfillment, inventory, shipping, SKU setup, pricing, and launch operations.
* Self\-starter capable of managing multiple workstreams and external partners with limited oversight.
* **Location:** Remote\-friendly across the U.S., with hybrid co\-working options available in Bozeman, MT, San Rafael, CA, or Golden, CO (our three office hubs).
* **Travel Requirements:** 2 team retreat/collaboration trips per year to a hub location, plus 2–3 additional business trips as needed (e.g., fulfillment center visits, trade shows).

#### **Preferred:**


* Hands\-on experience with Shopify Plus, ERP, WMS/3PL integrations, ticketing/live\-chat platforms, CRM tools, BI/reporting platforms, or marketplace channels.
* Understanding of APIs, webhooks, EDI, middleware, data mapping, UAT, and change\-management processes.
* Background in consumer products, retail, wholesale, or e\-commerce.

**Salary and benefits**
-----------------------


* Expected base salary range:$80k\-$110k.Offered compensation will vary based on geographic location, relevant experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance.
* Eligible for bi\-annual performance bonus and annual company bonus
* Unlimited PTO and 13 paid holidays
* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* 401(k) with up to 5% company match
* Monthly cell phone stipend
* Remote\-first

**Additional details**
----------------------



High Camp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Applicants must be currently authorized to permanently work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor employment visas or provide relocation assistance for this role.

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager, Model Quality
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Product Operations Manager to join our Product Operations Foundations team and drive model quality across all Meta surfaces. We are in the middle of a transformation, becoming an AI\-driven, IC\-led organization that scales through orchestration, deep product expertise, and technical excellence. Our team is building and operating autonomous agents that handle end\-to\-end workflows (triage, bug resolution, launches, dogfooding, evals) with minimal human intervention. If you're energized by owning complex quality programs end\-to\-end, building and operating AI\-driven workflows, and driving measurable product improvements in a fast\-paced environment, this role is for you. You will be responsible for managing and evaluating our AI solutions and infrastructure to improve precision, prevent drift, and maintain real\-time observability. This role is expected to set strategy for LLM models, determine areas of investment for increasing accuracy, advise leadership on impending risks, define roadmaps and reporting strategy to shape the future of our AI work. As part of this work, you will be expected to build and maintain industry\-wide expertise, develop effective cross\-functional relationships, advise engineering and cross\-functional partners on areas of investment, determine staffing needs, and solution against critical bottlenecks.  

  

  

### **Product Operations Manager, Model Quality Responsibilities:**

* Defines the technical direction for model maintenance (retraining cadences, drift mitigation, performance recovery) and evolution (new capabilities, architecture improvements, multi\-modal expansion). Translates cross\-product performance patterns into investment recommendations for evaluation leads
* Provides cross\-product context, defines what good looks like at the model level, and informs evaluation methodology. Evals owners own execution of verification pipelines within their products
* this role ensures consistency and identifies gaps across the portfolio while building institutional competence by surfacing performance patterns and proven methodologies, enabling evals captains' ability to execute and unblocking them as needed
* Defines what leadership needs to see, how model health should be measured and reported, and what thresholds trigger escalation
* Provides thought partnership to evals managers on narrative of model health, provides visibility into our classification strategy and accuracy measurement process
* Works with evaluation managers to drive cross\-app taxonomy alignment in alignment with cross\-functional needs and advises on a strategy for the migration of LLM accuracy assessment to judges
* Owns the consolidated view of all production model performance, identifies systemic patterns and emerging risks, and ensures leadership can verify model health on demand
* Partners with AI Implementations, operational systems teams and the Metrics \& Measurement team to build and maintain the infrastructure that surfaces this information
* Establishes performance guardrails that evals captains implement. Continuously scans industry developments and best practices to incorporate into org\-wide approach
* Maintains a tight feedback loop with product and eng teams across apps to ensure alignment on production priorities and deployment risks
* Deploys deep SME expertise to diagnose, unblock and directly resolve technical bottlenecks to complex model quality problems (atrophy, accuracy regressions, performance plateaus) when evaluation leads encounter blockers they cannot resolve independently
* Drives alignment with cross\-functional teams (quality and reliability partner teams) on tooling needs to support Product Operations classification strategy (ML classification tooling for initial\-tier classification, user voice, breakdown graphs). Advocates for investment, flags risks, influences direction

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a directly related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 7\+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or data analysis
* Analytical experience using data to tell a story and influence product direction using intermediate to advanced SQL
* Experience building or deploying AI/ML solutions, LLM model quality or automation in production workflows
* Strong communication skills with ability to influence multiple cross\-functional stakeholders and senior leadership
* Experience breaking down ambiguous issues into component parts to develop solutions
* Ability to design AI workflows that operate effectively within enterprise data sensitivity constraints, balancing quality and privacy principles

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience operating in flat, IC\-heavy org structures with high individual autonomy
* Demonstrated history of evaluating industry best practices and providing organizational recommendations on approaches to AI models and development
* Experience in product quality, QA, or technical program management
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, or ML evaluation frameworks
* Experience working with global/remote teams

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the n
