jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager provides the overall planning, coordination, and direction for project management activities to ensure they meet owner needs, specifications, cost, and schedule. May supervise office/field administrative staff, project/field engineers, assistant project/construction managers, project/construction managers and other assigned staff. This position will support construction in the Education Sector. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**
The Senior Project Manager is responsible for providing the following services or for supervising the Project Management team members that perform these services:* Primary contact and liaison for owner and principal partner entities for the contract, design, systems, procedures and related deliverables
* Develops project specific procedures and documentation, and consults with Owner on design and construction contracts and related A/E systems for the project
* Ensures contracts, drawings, estimates, and specifications comply with construction/project requirements
* Obtains, maintains, and manages data, information, communications, and approvals required by project and company requirements between owner, architects, engineers, and other project\-related entities
* Represents owner, project and related parties in public forums and meetings
* Manages project controls, cost, and performance activities and procedures, project logistics, organization, systems and project closeout
* Leads in project meetings to include documentation, administration, and tracking of relevant information and statuses
* Coordinates, directs, and monitors activities of construction management staff, contractors, engineers, architects, and related performing entities
* Ensures project team adheres to safety requirements
* Manages bid phase services, as may be required by the client
* Performs other duties as required

**Minimum Qualifications:*** Bachelor's degree in engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or equivalent is required
* 9\+ years of experience as a construction Project Manager
* 5\+ years working on DSA public education projects
* Advanced knowledge and application of project development, design\-phase management, construction estimating, cost, project controls/scheduling, documentation, engineering/construction principles, contracts and delivery methods are required
* Thorough understanding of contracts, documents, drawings, and specifications and applied experience in the areas of project accounting, cost, administrative, and personnel interaction in professional settings are required
* Strong computer skills and familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite products, and experience with project\-related systems such as Prolog and Primavera are required
* Proficiency with various document control systems, as well as new construction and modernization of K\-12 schools is preferred
* Registration as an Architect or Professional Engineer is preferred
* Certified Construction Manager preferred

 **Benefits**
Vanir offers a comprehensive, competitive benefits package that includes 401(k) Savings with employer matching contributions, medical, dental, vision, health savings account (HSA) with employer contributions, life, AD\&D and disability benefits, flexible spending account (FSA), voluntary benefits, Teladoc, pet insurance, paid time off, national employee assistance program (EAP) and employee referral program.  

\#LI\-GK1  

If you're interested in working for Vanir please visit our website to learn more and to apply online at www.vanir.com.  

VEVRAA Federal Contractor
Request Priority Protected Veteran Referrals
EOE Minorities/Females/Protected Veterans/Disabled  

Contact Email: careers@vanir.com  

Persons with medical limitations may, with reasonable accommodations, be capable of performing the duties of this position. Such a determination must be made on an individual basis considering the person's limitations, the requirements of the position, and the company's ability to make reasonable accommodations to the person's limitations.

  

We Participate in E\-Verify  

Pursuant to the Ban The Box Act/Fair Chance Initiative, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  

Vanir is a proud minority\- and woman\-owned company, recognized as a national leader in program, project and construction management (PMCM) and real estate development. Since 1964, we have consistently exceeded client expectations. Ranked as a top PMCM firm by Engineering News\-Record (ENR) for more than three decades, our award\-winning team provides a full range of services to public and private sector clients in the aviation; healthcare; education (K\-12 and higher); justice and essential services; science and technology; state and local government; transportation; water and wastewater; energy; and commercial, residential and nonprofit markets.

jobs.title: Operations Lead, Megapack
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
Tesla is seeking a Development Operations Lead to serve as the operational backbone of Tesla Energy’s project development organization. This role will build the systems, processes, and workflows that enable the team to scale across solar, storage, and powered land projects.


The Operations Lead will own the team’s project management infrastructure — processes, budget tracking, vendor management, legal and contract coordination, and cross\-functional reporting. This person will ensure that nothing falls through the cracks as the pipeline grows, and will be a key enabler of the team’s speed and execution quality.


Successful candidates will have deep experience in renewable energy development operations and a builder’s mentality. We are seeking someone who thrives in ambiguity, can stand up processes from scratch, and has a passion for Tesla’s mission to accelerate the world’s transition to sustainable energy.

 **What You'll Do*** Design and implement the development team’s project management framework, including stage\-gate processes, milestone tracking, and go/no\-go decision workflows
* Own development budget tracking and reporting across the full portfolio, ensuring spend aligns with strategic priorities and capital allocation plans
* Manage vendor and consultant relationships (environmental, survey, legal, title) and negotiate master service agreements
* Coordinate land acquisition and legal workflows, including option agreements, lease negotiations, title/survey coordination, interconnection deposits, and permitting applications
* Build reporting dashboards and KPI frameworks to give leadership real\-time visibility into pipeline health, spend, and risk
* Develop and maintain internal knowledge management systems, templates, and playbooks for repeatable development processes
* Drive cross\-functional coordination between development, interconnection, origination, engineering, and finance workstreams
  

**What You'll Bring*** 5–12\+ years in renewable energy development operations, project management, or infrastructure project delivery
* Experience building or significantly scaling development operations at a utility\-scale solar, storage, or wind developer
* Strong proficiency in project management tools and experience building portfolio\-level tracking systems
* Experience managing development budgets across large portfolios ($25M\+ annual spend)
* Familiarity with the full renewable energy development lifecycle from site identification through NTP, including land, permitting, interconnection, and offtake milestones
* Experience with land acquisition workflows — option agreements, lease negotiations, title review, and closing processes
#### **Benefits**

  

Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:


* Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
  
  

#### **Expected Compensation**


$136,000 \- $264,000/annual salary \+ cash and stock awards \+ benefits
Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

  

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.  

  

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
We invite you to consider an opportunity with Denali to help achieve our goal of delivering meaningful therapeutics to patients.


This role supports strategy development and manages timelines, risks, and budgets for advancing candidates through research, preclinical, and clinical development. It leads project teams, supports business development, and ensures portfolio decisions align with broader pipeline objectives.
Key Accountabilities/Core Job Responsibilities :


* Support strategy development and manage integrated project plans, timeline, risks and costs associated with development of candidate progression through research, pre\-clinical and clinical development.
* Work hand\-in\-hand with the Project Leader and Technical Team Leaders to co\-lead drug development project teams, technology platform project teams, and biological pathway project teams, including Core Strategy Teams and Technical Sub teams.
* Guide team and facilitate discussions to frame and assess development options based on portfolio context and contribute to excellent portfolio management by placing program decisions into the context of the broader pipeline.
* Drive effective communication and decision making in a fast\-paced environment.
* Work with business development in diligence and execution of new collaborations.
* Manage and track project metrics including timelines, budgets and risks.

Qualifications/Skills :


* Bachelor's degree required; PhD in Chemistry, Biology, or a related scientific discipline preferred.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Flooring Solutions, Inc. (FSI), a commercial flooring contractor and distributor based in Livermore, CA, is seeking an organized and proactive Project Manager to oversee commercial flooring installations from bid award through closeout. This role owns the day\-to\-day coordination of materials, installers, subcontractors, and documentation that keeps flooring projects on schedule and within budget. The ideal candidate thrives on staying organized across multiple active jobs, communicates clearly with account managers, installers, and clients, and takes pride in a clean, well\-documented project file from start to finish.

Duties

* Review bid packages, contracts, plans, and specifications from Account Managers to confirm project scope and requirements
* Coordinate compliance documentation, including prevailing wage requirements, pre\-lien waivers, safety program acknowledgments, and OSHA certifications
* Manage submittals and project documents: product samples and specs, drawings, MSDS sheets, W\-9s, vendor setup, and contact sheets
* Track change orders and confirm proper acknowledgment and billing
* Prepare schedule of values and manage billing/invoicing through platforms such as Textura and Procore
* Submit material orders to Purchasing and confirm delivery ETAs
* Maintain the master installation calendar and project tracking system across all active jobs
* Coordinate material deliveries with vendors, the warehouse, and jobsites
* Communicate with in\-house installers and subcontractors to confirm scheduling, staging, and manpower needs
* Arrange and participate in job walks, pre\-construction meetings, and punch walks
* Create work orders for warehouse pull slips and installers
* Serve as the primary point of contact between Account Managers, installers, and clients, keeping all parties updated on progress, delays, or changes
* Provide customers with delivery confirmations and schedule updates
* Conduct regular project review meetings with Account Managers
* Confirm labor costs align with estimated costs on work orders
* Prepare closeout packages, including warranties, maintenance guides, manuals, and final signoffs
* Upload required documents to GC/Owner portals (Procore, Textura, etc.) and confirm project files are complete and archived

Qualifications

* Prior experience as a Project Manager, Project Coordinator, or similar role in commercial flooring, construction, or a related trade
* Working knowledge of flooring materials and installation methods (carpet tile, resilient flooring, LVT, VCT, etc.) preferred
* Familiarity with construction documentation, including schedule of values, lien waivers, change orders, and certified payroll/prevailing wage requirements
* Experience with project management or billing platforms such as Procore, Textura, or similar
* Ability to read and interpret plans, specifications, and contracts
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
* Clear, professional communication skills for coordinating with Account Managers, installers, subcontractors, and clients
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word)
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to accurate, well\-maintained project documentation

Join FSI's project management team and play a key role in delivering commercial flooring projects that our clients and partners can count on.

Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Program Manager, Security Risk Program
jobs.description:
We are building a governance, risk, and compliance function to enable our company to buildproducts that can withstand regulatory scrutiny, and ensure Meta continues to meet globalregulatory requirements and manage risk. Meta's Risk and Compliance Program (RCP) is the central engine driving risk management and compliance at the company, supporting Meta and the family of apps. Within RCP, the Security Risk Program (SRP) is the second\-line function accountable for how Meta identifies, assesses, quantifies, and reports its security risk posture — delivering global security risk assessments, Capability Maturity \& Effectiveness (CME) evaluations, AI and cloud risk assessments, and board\-level and regulatory reporting.We are seeking a Security Risk Program Manager to build one of the program's highest\-priority new capabilities: security risk assessment of AI product launches. Today, AI launches receivead\-hoc coverage through security risk assessments designed for infrastructure — not forproduct\-launch cadence, and not for cross\-domain AI risk spanning Security, Privacy, Integrity,and Legal. You will design that capability from the ground up and scale it from roughly fiveassessments per quarter today to twenty or more per quarter by H1 2027, in step with Meta's AIproduct velocity.This is a builder and an influencer role in equal measure. AI launch risk cannot beassessed by one function acting alone — it requires Central Security, product groups, Privacy,Integrity, and Legal moving through a shared process on a launch timeline. You will own thatoperating model: translating product and engineering reality into a defensible risk position, andtranslating regulatory obligation into assessment work that product teams can actually absorbwithout stalling a launch. The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, effective inhigh\-pressure and fast\-moving situations, and able to build durable relationships across a widerange of technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

* Design and implement Meta's AI Launch Risk Assessment framework end to end — intake criteria, cross\-domain risk taxonomy, assessment methodology, and launch\-gate outputs — and scale delivery from \~5 to 20\+ assessments per quarter by H1 2027\.
* Build and partner to manage the XFN operating model that coordinates Central Security, product groups, Privacy Risk Management, Integrity Risk Management, and Legal through each assessment, with clear roles, handoffs, and decision rights on a launch timeline.
* Partner directly with product and engineering teams on high\-priority AI launches — engaging early enough that security risk review informs design decisions rather than gating release, and giving product teams a predictable, well\-documented path through second\-line review.
* Serve as the connection point between the Security Risk Program, Central Security leadership, Legal, and first\-line business teams, representing security risk positions and negotiating assessment scope, sequencing, and remediation commitments.
* Build and maintain a consolidated AI risk register that gives leadership a single view of.
* security risk across the AI product portfolio, and produce the reporting that keeps that view current for VP and executive audiences.

* submission\-ready, and constitute defensible evidence of systematic security due diligence for regulators and auditors (including EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF expectations).

* Create and facilitate presentations that build senior leadership understanding and influence decision\-making, and provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members on program design and assessment practice.

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of experience in governance, risk, and compliance, security risk management,
* regulatory compliance, or a directly related discipline

jobs.description:
**Program Manager**

  

  

**Location:** Hybrid; California\-based, with a strong preference for the San Francisco Bay Area  

**Status:** Full\-time, Exempt  

**Reports to:** Program Director  

**Salary Range:** $76,800–$115,200  

  

**About the Center for Care Innovations**  

The Center for Care Innovations (CCI) is a nonprofit organization working to transform the health care safety net. Our mission is to spark, seed, and spread innovations that strengthen the health and wellbeing of historically underinvested communities.  

  

For more than 25 years, CCI has worked alongside safety net organizations to navigate a changing health care landscape, test new approaches, strengthen organizations and leaders, and help promising ideas spread across the field. Rooted in California, we partner with community health centers, public hospitals, community\-based organizations, managed care plans, public agencies, and philanthropy.  

  

Our work spans capacity\-building initiatives, advising and consulting, and ecosystem development: running intensive learning collaboratives and accelerators, providing tailored advising and research, and hosting cross\-sector gatherings. These bring people together to tackle some of the health care safety net's most pressing challenges.

  

  

For more information, please see the www.careinnovations.org (http://www.careinnovations.org/).
  

  

**About the Program Manager Role**  

CCI is looking for a collaborative, curious, and organized Program Manager to design and lead initiatives that help health care safety net organizations improve care and advance health equity. This is a great role for someone who enjoys moving between strategy and implementation, turning big ideas into actionable initiatives, building strong relationships, making sense of data and complex information, facilitating engaging learning experiences, and keeping complex work moving forward.  

  

We're looking for someone who understands the health care safety net ecosystem and brings deeper experience in at least one part of it. This is a highly relational and outward\-facing role, working with health care organizations, funders, partners, and other stakeholders in both virtual and in\-person settings.  

  

**What** **You'll Do**


* **Design initiatives that respond to real\-world challenges.** Work with CCI colleagues and partners to translate ideas into actionable initiatives through landscape research, stakeholder interviews, work planning, and the development of content and learning experiences. Depending on the initiative, you may draw on approaches such as human\-centered design, quality improvement, and other methods for supporting organizational and systems change.


* **Lead initiatives through implementation.** Manage the day\-to\-day work of multiple initiatives, including timelines, deliverables, budgets, team roles, consultants, and grant requirements. Anticipate challenges, solve problems, coordinate work across teams, and help teams adjust as the work evolves.


* **Build and steward strong relationships.** Develop trusted relationships with key stakeholders, bringing a responsive, collaborative, equity\-centered, and service\-oriented approach to the work.


* **Create engaging learning experiences.** Design and confidently facilitate virtual and in\-person convenings, workshops, meetings, and other learning experiences. Prepare speakers and partners, develop agendas and activities, present content, facilitate conversations, and create welcoming spaces where participants can learn from one another and put new ideas into practice.


* **Use data to learn, improve, and communicate impact.** Gather, analyze, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data to understand how initiatives are progressing, identify opportunities for improvement, and inform decision\-making. Translate findings and complex information into clear insights and recommendations for internal teams, participants, partners, and funders.


* **Manage grants, contracts, and funder relationships.** Manage initiative budgets, track spending, contribute to narrative and data\-driven funder reports, and communicate clearly with funders about progress, learning, challenges, and results. Support the identification and management of faculty, coaches, consultants, and other partners.


**You Might Be a Great Fit If You...**


* Have at least five years of experience managing complex initiatives, ideally in health care, public health, nonprofit, community\-based, or related settings.


* Have a master's degree in public health, public policy, health care administration, nonprofit management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


* Bring a strong understanding of the health care safety net ecosystem, with deeper knowledge or experience in at least one area, such as Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), Medi\-Cal Managed Care Plans, or other California safety net organizations.


* Have experience running or supporting learning collaboratives, accelerators, technical assistance initiatives, or other capacity\-building efforts.


* Are an excellent manager who can translate broad goals into clear work plans, timelines, roles, and deliverables and keep complex work moving forward.


* Are skilled at developing and maintaining trusted relationships with partners and stakeholders.


* Are a confident and engaging communicator who can present, facilitate, and translate complex information clearly for a range of audiences, including funders and external partners, both virtually and in person.


* Have strong quantitative and qualitative data analysis skills and can use data to inform decision\-making, learning, and communication.


* Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, solving problems, experimenting with new approaches, and adjusting course as you learn.


* Bring a commitment to advancing health equity and improving care for historically underinvested

jobs.description:
Part\-Time Landscape Project Coordinator

**Rendered Stone Landscapes \| East Bay, CA**  
**Starting at 10\-15 hours/week, with potential to grow to twice that \+**  
**$28\-30/hour to start DOE**

Rendered Stone Landscapes is looking for a **highly organized, reliable, and people\-oriented Project Coordinator** to help coordinate our landscape installation projects and become an important part of our client experience.

This is a part\-time position to start, with approximately **10\-15 hours per week and the potential to grow** to twice that as the role expands. For the first few months, you will work closely with the owners to learn our projects, systems, clients, crew, and standards. As you become comfortable in the role, you will gradually take on more responsibility for day\-to\-day project coordination, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day\-to\-day coordination while continuing to work closely with the ownership team.

**What You'll Do**

You will help guide projects from the beginning of construction through completion, working closely with our clients, field crew, vendors, office team and company owners.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Serving as a primary point of contact for clients during active construction
* Communicating clearly, professionally, kindly, and proactively with clients
* Coordinating schedules, materials, deliveries, subcontractors, and jobsite logistics
* Visiting active jobsites to monitor progress, organization, and quality
* Reviewing plans and ensuring the work being built reflects the approved design and scope
* Maintaining high standards for craftsmanship, details, cleanliness, and overall presentation
* Communicating clearly with the field crew and helping resolve questions or issues as they arise
* Identifying potential problems early and helping develop practical solutions
* Keeping projects organized and on track with established scope, schedule, and cost targets
* Documenting project progress, decisions, changes, and client communication
* Helping coordinate change requests and ensuring work outside the approved scope is properly addressed
* Participating in client meetings, site walks, and project closeouts

You will **not** be responsible for estimating, setting project pricing, budgeting, payroll, or making company financial decisions.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is **extremely dependable, organized, communicative, and thoughtful**. You don't need to be a landscape architect or designer, but you do need to understand landscape construction and have a genuine interest in how things are built.

The right person will:

* Have strong practical knowledge of landscape construction, hardscape, irrigation, planting, or related construction
* Be able to read and understand plans and translate them into real\-world construction
* Have exceptionally strong communication skills
* Be comfortable and confident working directly with clients
* Be kind, patient, and professional even and especially when dealing with difficult situations
* Communicate confidently and respectfully with field crews while maintaining clear expectations and a collaborative working relationship
* Have a high standard for craftsmanship and attention to detail
* Notice when something isn't right and be willing to speak up
* Be proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do
* Be highly organized and capable of keeping track of many moving pieces
* Be comfortable taking ownership and following things through to completion
* Understand that the details of the client experience matter just as much as the finished landscape

We are a **small, high\-end boutique landscape design and installation company**, and our clients expect a thoughtful, professional, highly communicative experience. We are looking for someone who naturally understands that standard and can help us maintain it as the company grows.

**Growth \& Training**

This position will begin with approximately **10\-15 hours per week**, with the potential to grow to twice that as responsibilities increase.

Initially, you will **shadow the owner and learn how we manage projects, communicate with clients, work with our crew, and maintain our standards**. As you become familiar with our way of working, you will gradually take on more responsibility for coordinating projects and installations, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day\-to\-day coordination as one of the owners steps back from that role. You will continue to work closely alongside the other owner and our field leadership.

We are looking for someone who is naturally intuitive, observant, and proactive. A good candidate is someone who notices what needs attention, anticipates problems before they become problems, and can often see the next step without having to be told. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build their skills, take on increasing responsibility, and grow with the company over time.

**Why Work With Us**

We are a growing company with a collaborative team culture and a genuine commitment to the people who work with us. We care about doing excellent work, treating people well, and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding our employee benefits and opportunities, including:

* Competitive hourly compensation
* Performance\-based bonuses
* Employee discounts
* PTO
* Opportunities for advancement and increasing responsibility
* A supportive, collaborative team environment
* A company culture that values communication, respect, craftsmanship, and personal growth
* Benefits currently being developed, including a 401(k) with employer matching and healthcare benefits for eligiible candidates

jobs.title: Mental Health Care Coordinator for High Needs Youth
jobs.description:
WestCoast Children's Clinic, located in Oakland, California, is a non\-profit community psychology clinic that provides mental health services to Bay Area children, youth and families. ***Working at WestCoast Children's Clinic means being part of an organization that is client\-centered, trauma\-informed, collaborative, and committed to justice and equity.***

**Position Details**


**Title**: Outpatient and C\-Change Intensive Care Coordinator (ICC)


**Classification**: Regular Full Time (1\.0 FTE), Non\-exempt (Hourly)


**Location**: Oakland, CA / Hybrid (availability to provide client services in\-person and complete documentation remotely)


**Regular Work Schedule**: Full time, M\-F


**Compensation:**


* $34\.62 per hour


The **Mental Health Care Coordinator,** formally known as the Intensive Care Coordinator (ICC) is responsible for the assessment, development, coordination, implementation, and oversight of intensive behavioral health, community\-based care plans for moderate to high\-acuity clients with complex behavioral health, medical, developmental, and/or psychosocial needs. The ICC identifies and brings together family, natural supports (friends, extended family, neighbors, community members) and formal system partners (child welfare, school, juvenile probation, etc.) to form a Child \& Family Team (CFT) which collectively works together to address goals and ensure successful and enduring change.



The ICC exercises clinical judgment and discretion in collaboratively evaluating client needs and strengths, determining appropriate interventions, coordinating interdisciplinary treatment services, managing crises, resource linkage, behavioral skill building and developing individualized care strategies guided by the Integrated Core Practice Model. The ICC coordinates and facilitates regular CFT meetings among teams, and monitors and contributes to progress toward a youth's goals.



The work is varied in character, requiring interpretation of clinical information, application of professional standards, and clinically informed decision\-making. ICCs provide services and participate in agency meetings in a combination of environments including virtual (zoom / phone) and in\-person office or community locations (drop\-in center, client homes, school, parks, etc.). This position primarily serves youth and young adults in the C\-Change program.


**About the C\-Change Program**



The C\-Change Program, supports the transformation of the lives of youth who are at risk or have been identified as sexually exploited minors by focusing on supporting stabilization, reducing mental health symptoms, self efficacy and self determination, community building, and connecting youth with other resources. Our specialized approach provides mental health screening, advocacy, clinical case management, and psychotherapy to at\-risk youth. C\-Change provides services to youth who are up to 21 years old and reside throughout the Bay Area.

jobs.title: TAY Supportive Services Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Mission Statement**


Through the use of social and restorative justice principles, Five Keys provides traditionally underserved communities the opportunity to improve their lives through a focus on the Five Keys: EDUCATION, EMPLOYMENT, RECOVERY, FAMILY, COMMUNITY.




**Five Keys Overview**


Five Keys is a nonprofit organization that operates an extensive network of programs across California. With a presence in 14 counties and over 120 locations, Five Keys focuses on various initiatives aimed at empowering individuals and families to overcome poverty and inequity. The organization's programs encompass a wide range of services, including public charter schools, restorative justice programs in jails and prisons, shelters, permanent supportive housing, and the development of new housing and support programs. At Five Keys, the overarching objective is to uplift individuals and families by providing them with essential resources. This includes education, housing, employment, and the necessary tools to sustain their progress. By offering these fundamental elements, the organization aims to create positive and lasting change in communities, making them better places for everyone.




**Our Core Competencies**


A well qualified candidate has the capacity to communicate effectively, collaborate with others while building positive relationships, demonstrates strong problem solving skills, has a dynamic learning mindset, and remains committed to a high level of cultural and social awareness. A successful candidate will work well under pressure, observe appropriate boundaries and operate with a high degree of emotional intelligence.




**What it’s really like to join our agency…**


At Five Keys, culture matters. Culture is at the very core of everything we do and impact on a daily basis. We’ve made a commitment to building an inclusive culture that seeks collaboration over hierarchy to create empowered work teams. We serve vulnerable populations daily and we strive to approach everyone with compassion, patience and a trauma informed approach. We choose to push past discomfort to have difficult conversations to impact the greater good. This allows us the opportunity to collaboratively create an inclusive culture and transform the world around us.




**BENEFITS**


We offer very low monthly costs for medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with generous time off! Various pre\-tax flexible spending accounts and retirement account 403(b) are available. We provide annual reimbursements up to $100 towards gym membership, smoking cessation, and weight loss programs. Annual athletic event participation and annual massages are reimbursed up to $50\. Other Company\-paid benefits, including free wellness\-related apps, an Employee Assistance Program, and a comprehensive mental health care platform, are available to you and your dependents.  



**JOB SUMMARY**


The Transitional Age Youth (TAY) Supportive Services Care Coordinator reports to the Assistant Director of TAY Rapid Rehousing and is accountable for providing housing\-focused care coordination services to San Francisco clients (ages 18–27\) who receive rapid rehousing rental assistance through the San Francisco Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing and other City departments. This role requires a strong commitment to supporting youth as they transition out of homelessness, helping them build the skills and stability needed for long\-term self\-sufficiency. Team members are expected to demonstrate professionalism and integrity in every aspect of their work, ensuring the highest standards of service and opportunity for clients, community partners, and colleagues.




We are looking for someone who insists on maintaining a positive attitude and enjoys supporting a diverse group of people. If this job is for you, you are someone who is compassionate, collaborative, and deeply committed to equity and inclusion. You thrive in a fast\-paced environment, value the importance of strong client relationships, and are passionate about making a lasting impact in the lives of transitional age youth.




**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


Care Coordinator Duties

* Assist TAY participants with securing housing by providing navigation support, including accompanying them to view available units, helping complete housing applications, and facilitating access to credit and background reports as needed
* Support TAY participants in understanding their tenant rights, lease responsibilities, and requirements
* Provide guidance on timely rent payments, and coach them on effective communication and conflict resolution with landlords
* Develop case management plans and connect clients with community and government resources to avoid loss of benefits and to increase the likelihood of housing stability
* Deliver supportive services to help clients stabilize their housing, enhance their mental and physical well\-being, and build greater self\-sufficiency
* Make referrals and coordinate services that lead to increased housing stability, increased income, job placement assistance, and retention
* Work collaboratively with the rental assistance provider to determine and calculate appropriate rental assistance amounts for clients
* Support participants with swiftly transitioning out of the Rapid Rehousing Rental Assistance program while ensuring housing stabilization
* Plan and lead group Life Skills sessions covering topics such as budgeting, financial management, housing search strategies, nutrition, tenant\-landlord relationships, tenants’ rights, health education, healthcare navigation, and parenting, as applicable
* Develop and maintain comprehensive records for participating clients, including detailed case documentation and regular report reviews
* Compile and analyze data to prepare summary reports, ensuring all case files comply with both Five Keys case management standards and Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing (HSH) requiremen

**About Prudentia Sciences**
----------------------------


Prudentia Sciences is the scientific intelligence layer powering life sciences dealmaking. We bring together expert\-developed scientific diligence frameworks, AI reasoning trained on drug development, and a unified evidence base to accelerate investment in breakthrough therapies. As a trusted third party operating between buyer and seller, we help build conviction through every stage of the deal, faster. We replace fragmented workflows with a single system that surfaces what matters earlier.


Backed by GV (Google Ventures), McKesson, Iaso Ventures, Virtue, and SignalFire — and built by people who have sat on every side of the table in life sciences dealmaking — we're on a mission to bring expert scientific judgment to every deal decision, at AI scale.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a Customer Delivery \& Support Lead to own implementation and support for Prudentia's biopharma customers. You'll turn how a client's team actually works into a live deployment: you're mapping workflows, configuring the platform, collaborating with engineering on custom development and integrations, and making sure every account has fast and reliable product support.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**Implementation \& Deployment**

* Translate ambiguous client workflows into clear implementation plans and configuration blueprints, then execute against them for deployment go\-lives
* Support customer workshops and configuration sessions with client teams to map workflows and accelerate time\-to\-value
* Build reusable configuration patterns and implementation playbooks that speed up delivery across the customer portfolio

* Own ticket resolution end\-to\-end, maintaining response and resolution times and escalating as needed
* Build and maintain a customer\-facing Knowledge Base that makes self\-services the fastest path to resolution

**Continuous Improvement**

* Turn recurring technical issues and workflow gaps into structured feedback for Product and Engineering
* Maintain deep platform expertise, including emerging AI and agentic workflow capabilities, to enable clients’ sophisticated use cases
* Track implementation and support metrics (time\-to\-deploy, resolution time, recurring issue rate) to continuously sharpen delivery quality

**Who You Are**
---------------

**Essential Qualifications**

* 5\+ years in technical implementation, solutions consulting, technical support, or platform configuration within enterprise SaaS or data platforms
* Strong troubleshooting instincts: able to diagnose issues systematically and communicate clearly with both customers and engineers
* Ability to translate ambiguous business workflows into a technical build with clear documentation, protecting delivery timelines when scope or priorities shift
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment where priorities evolve quickly

**Bonus Points**

* Experience in pharmaceutical, biopharma, biotech, or another regulated enterprise environment
* Familiarity with AI/ML platforms, workflow automation, or agentic tooling
* Experience building internal documentation, playbooks, or knowledge bases
* Proficiency with customer support or success platforms (HubSpot, Zendesk, or similar)

* **Ownership:** Build and lead the platform as a foundational engineering leader
* **Growth:** Shape our product experience during a critical scaling phase
* **Compensation:** Competitive salary and equity
* **Team:** Collaborative, mission\-driven colleagues passionate about transforming biopharma

We are strongly prioritizing candidates who can be flexibly hybrid twice per week (Tues/Thurs) from our Boston, NYC, or San Francisco office. If we find truly exceptional talent, we may consider fully remote in Eastern Time Zone in the United States.


Compensation Range: $203K \- $252K

jobs.description:
Introduction:

Join us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!  

We’re problem solvers, driven by our curiosity and creativity, in endless pursuit of solutions for our customers. Together, we champion the strength of our global teams. And, as trusted advisors, we go above and beyond, working together in a supportive and collaborative environment to ensure customer satisfaction.  

Through the company's continued growth, we challenge ourselves to be better, continuously learning and growing in our dynamic environment. Helping others is at the core of our culture, join us in finding fulfillment by giving back to our local communities as the united team that is AIT. Find out what **our people deliver.®** means when you come move the world with us!  

Hear directly from our teammates at AIT Worldwide Logistics and make us the next stop on your career journey.
Overview:

The **Domestic Customer Account Manager** is responsible for day\-to\-day management of, and expanding, the client relationship. In addition, the role will be responsible for customer service (24/7\), tracking, routing, problem resolution, vendor compliance, account profitability, and all other assigned projects as dictated by the needs of the client. This role requires excellent organizational and communication skills while working in a high volume and fast paced environment. The Customer Account Manager is the primary point of contact for a large revenue\-producing and more complex customer base responsible for all steps in the logistics process for these customer(s), which may not be routine in nature.
Responsibilities:
* High visibility role acting as the primary contact for larger, more complex or high\-revenue producing customers, responsible for the outcome of assigned projects and customized client solutions.
* Main point of contact for clients supporting all of their logistics needs from beginning to end, including:
* + Ability to quote and route freight across multiple transportation channels and services
	+ Track and trace shipments daily
	+ Able to troubleshoot and overcome operational challenges
	+ Act as the local point\-of\-contact for all client inquiries, both operational and sales related
	+ Provide timely analysis and monitor freight cost metrics
* Work with multiple decision\-makers within the assigned account to drive business development through multiple channels
* Adhere to TSA and other government regulatory compliance standards with regards to booking, routing of all air, ground and sea cargo
* Achieve service goals by working with various AIT internal groups to develop, implement and monitor logistic metrics
* Work with the client on any and all reporting requests
* Responsible for development and updating SOPs for various business segments
* All other duties as needed
* The wage range for this position is $71,860\.00\-$107,780\.00 and may vary based on geography as well as relative knowledge, skills, abilities, and experience.


Qualifications:
* Minimum basic qualifications: High school degree or GED required
* Associates degree or higher preferred
* 3\-5 years previous Freight Forwarding experience
* Proficient in MS Word, Excel, AS400 experience preferred, but not required
* Ability to multi\-task with strong attention to detail
* Must be able to work in a team setting and autonomously to determine resources to meet and exceed company and customer expectations
* Ability to problem solve and be solution oriented
* Individual must have a self\-starter mentality and is adaptive and flexible
* Ability to calculate freight rates and amounts such percentages, area, circumference, and volume


What AIT Can Offer You:

In addition to your base compensation, you may be eligible for a bonus based on achievement of business and/or individual performance metrics (dependent on position). Benefits offered include Medical, Prescription, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, Dental, Vision, Life, AD\&D, Disability, Supplemental Health, Employee Support, Paid Parental Leave, Pet Insurance, 401(k) and Tuition Reimbursement. In addition, teammates may be eligible for up to 10 to 20 days of vacation (depending on tenure), 2 personal days, 1 floating holiday, 5 sick days, 5 volunteer hours, and 6 company holidays (plus Veterans Day for Veterans) annually.

AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps companies grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure their raw materials, components and finished goods. Backed by scalable, user\-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door\-to\-door deliveries via sea, air, ground and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 150 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe and North America, AIT’s full\-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services. *AIT Worldwide Logistics is an Equal Opportunity Employer – M/F/Veterans/Disabled. If you are unable to apply online due to a disability, contact Human Resources at 630\-766\-8300 ext 5218\.*

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Location:** Bay Area


**Our Team:**

Semtech's commercial (sales) team is a high\-performing, strategic group driving Semtech's transformation into an industry\-leading demand generation organization. We recognize that our rep partners are strategic extensions of our go\-to\-market engine and critical force multipliers for reaching customers we can't serve directly. We thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment where tenacity, grit, and collaboration define our culture, measuring success by the trust we build with customers and partners, the innovative solutions we deliver together, and the market share we capture through disciplined execution.  



**Job Summary** **:**

The Strategic Account Manager is quota\-carrying regional sales position that will serve as a market share warrior, trusted customer advisor, and strategic partner orchestrator—driving explosive revenue growth through world\-class demand generation across direct accounts and rep\-covered territories. This high\-impact position combines strategic vision with competitive sales instincts, orchestrating complex deals while building best\-in\-class rep firm relationships that multiply market reach. You'll be part business strategist, part performance coach , part trusted advisor, and part market intelligence officer— leveraging deep customer intimacy and systematic rep enablement to outmaneuver competition.  



Your dual mandate spans the full Semtech portfolio: secure design wins with direct strategic accounts while building rep firm capability, alignment, and performance that amplifies your impact across territories. Success requires becoming a trusted advisor whom customers welcome into confidential discussions while creating strategic partnerships where rep firm success directly fuels Semtech's growth. You'll leverage consultative discovery to uncover business consequences and decision criteria driving customer choices, while coaching reps to do the same. Success will be measured by market share gains, customer and partner loyalty, design\-win velocity, and pipeline conversion at industry\-leading rates. Time allocation between direct accounts and rep firms flexes based on territory revenue mix and growth potential, requiring strategic prioritization and dynamic resource optimization.

* Develop and execute comprehensive account plans for assigned customer accounts using consultative discovery methodologies

* Partner with FAEs to drive technical evaluations, proof\-of\-concepts, and design\-in activities for direct accounts
* Translate customer technical requirements into compelling business cases and commercial proposals
* Track design\-win funnel from engagement through qualification and production ramp
* Build and maintain qualified pipeline of 3\-4x quota coverage with systematic opportunity progression
* Lead pricing negotiations, MSA/NDA execution, and commercial terms protecting margins

* Develop rep capability through product training, technical solution selling coaching, and market intelligence sharing
* Monitor rep/distributor/direct commission conflicts and resolve using proof\-of\-influence methodology
* Build territory coverage strategies optimizing rep allocation and identifying underperforming coverage areas
* Track rep firm metrics including trip reports, opportunity quality, forecast accuracy, and customer engagement effectiveness
* Initiate performance improvement plans when rep firms fall below standards, making recommendations for rep changes when necessary
* Negotiate territory assignments, commission structures, and resource allocation based on ROI justification
Business Operations \& Forecasting


* Deliver accurate monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts with appropriate lead\-time visibility incorporating rep firm inputs
* Maintain Salesforce accuracy ensuring pipeline hygiene and data quality across direct and rep\-managed opportunities
* Prepare and present Opportunity Reviews, Account Plans, Pipeline Reviews, and Rep QBRs to leadership
* Track and report KPIs including design\-win count, revenue attainment, win/loss ratios, rep performance metrics, and customer satisfaction
* Develop account\-specific and territory\-wide pricing strategies balancing competitiveness with profitability
* Maintain working knowledge of Semtech product portfolio and competitive alternatives

* Coordinate with supply chain and operations teams on demand planning, allocation, and new product introductions
* Establish collaborative relationships with Semtech account managers supporting ecosystem players
* Identify and engage technical influencers, consultants, and partners impacting customer technology selection
* Support marketing initiatives including customer succe

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Account Manager - Semiconductor
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Driving continued aggressive growth in our Enterprise business is a continued high priority. In the rapidly growing world of GenAI, multi\-modality is increasingly becoming a requirement.

  

In addition to text, use cases demand computer vision with reasoning, world action and speech modalities. We need an account manager to passionately drive these technologies in the Enterprise and win NVIDIA platform (Software \+ Hardware) adoption. You will drive GTM (go to market) aspects of the collaboration including but not limited to defining our GTM strategy (industry, partners), sales enablement materials, train partner and field, working with the sales account team on creating and closing pipeline opportunities and provide feedback to the product team based on customer requirements. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!

 **What you'll be doing:**

* Elevate and prioritize the most promising NVIDIA DSX, AI Infrastructure, EDA, and semiconductor ecosystem providers based on their capacity to scale, attract capital, and drive sustained sales offtake, while ensuring alignment with NVIDIA’s strategic priorities.
* Establish and execute a comprehensive NVIDIA DSX and semiconductor ecosystem go\-to\-market plan in collaboration with local and global partners.
* Lead GTM strategy and execution for the Physical AI ecosystem; monitor performance, identify gaps, and recommend data\-driven optimizations to increase offtake.
* Deliver incremental revenue and pipeline growth quarter over quarter, including the ability to structure and close complex business deals.
* Partner with internal teams to design full\-system solutions that enable the cloud business; provide ongoing strategic, product, and tactical feedback from headquarters.
* Collaborate closely with product, sales, and partnerships teams to maintain alignment on strategic priorities and execution.
* Represent NVIDIA at strategic industry forums; identify and drive participation in high\-value ecosystem events to build visibility, relationships, and partnerships.
* Own the event strategy, including evaluation, prioritization, and coverage planning for NVIDIA\-led and third\-party industry events.

**What we need to see:**

* 5\+ years of technology sales leadership experience with a consistent record of exceeding revenue and growth targets.
* Deep AI/ML domain expertise, particularly in enterprise AI, foundation models, and large language models (LLMs).
* Demonstrated success building executive relationships, establishing strategic partnerships, and leading complex deals in matrixed organizations.
* Strong solution architecture and business strategy capabilities, including development and execution of joint sales motions and GTM strategies.
* Expert understanding of the AI customer journey, adoption patterns, cloud technologies, and on\-premises data center and compute requirements.
* Degree in engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience; a master’s degree or MBA is highly desirable.
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% for national customer, partner, and ecosystem engagements.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Track record of successfully growing revenue for new, innovative technology\-based solutions, demonstrating deep experience in Physical AI.
* Proven knowledge of pricing strategies, channel economics, and influencing business practices and products to better align with customer needs.

  

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you.


Your cash compensation will be determined based on your location, experience and the pay of employees in similar positions with 85% paid through base salary and 15% variable compensation. jobs.title: Front Office Manager
jobs.description:
Compensation Type: Yearly Highgate Hotels:

Highgate is a leading real estate investment and hospitality management company with over $15 billion of assets under management and a global portfolio of more than 400 hotels spanning North America, Europe, the Caribbean, and Latin America. With a 30\-year track record as an innovator in the hospitality industry, this forward\-thinking company provides expert guidance through all stages of the property cycle, from planning and development through recapitalization or disposition. Highgate continues to demonstrate success in developing a diverse portfolio of bespoke lifestyle hotel brands, legacy brands, and independent hotels and resorts, featuring contemporary programming and digital acumen. The company utilizes industry\-leading revenue management tools that efficiently identify and predict evolving market dynamics to drive outperformance and maximize asset value. With an executive team of seasoned hospitality leaders and corporate offices worldwide, Highgate is a trusted partner for top ownership groups and major hotel brands. www.highgate.com
Location:  

Located atop San Francisco’s famed Nob Hill at the corner of California and Powell streets, Stanford Court hotel is steps from the city’s best dining, shopping, entertainment and cultural attractions. The hotel features 393 well\-appointed rooms and suites, offering comfortable accommodations for leisure and business travelers in a prime location. With a storied history dating back nearly 140 years, Stanford Court sits on the historic site of renowned “Big 4” railroad mogul, university founder, and U.S. senator Leland Stanford’s elaborate private mansion. Leland Stanford was at the forefront of innovation in his era, and today’s Stanford Court hotel pays homage to his legacy by representing the new frontier of innovation for the 21st century.
Overview:

The Front Office Manager is responsible for ensuring the operation of the Guest Services Department encompassing Telecommunications (PBX), Reservations and Uniformed Services/Transportation is attentive, friendly, efficient and courteous, providing all guests with quality service prior to and throughout their stay, while maximizing room revenue and occupancy. The department is comprised of associates represented by HERE Local 2 and Teamsters 856\. Union knowledge desired.
Responsibilities:
* Respond to all guests’ requests, problems, complaints and/or accidents presented at the Front Desk or through reservations, comment cards, letters and/or phone calls, in an attentive, courteous and efficient manner. Follow up to ensure guest satisfaction.
* Motivate, coach, counsel and discipline all Guest Services personnel according to Highgate Hotel S.O.P.'s.
* Carry a cell phone and be available as needed.
* Prepare and conduct all Guest Services interviews and follow hiring procedures according to Highgate Hotel S.O.P.'s.
* Develop employee morale and ensure training of Guest Services personnel.
* Maximize room revenue and occupancy by reviewing status daily. Analyze rate variance, monitor credit report and maintain close observation of daily house count. Monitor selling status of house daily, i.e. flash report, allowances, etc.
* Attend Ops, Resume, Safety and department meetings as directed.

jobs.title: Care Management Community Health Worker I
jobs.description:
**SUMMARY**: As part of an interdisciplinary team, provides culturally affirmative care coordination and advocacy for patients. This includes outreach and engagement, social assessments and development of the care plan, health coaching, and linkage to social resources and healthcare.


**DUTIES \& ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**: NOTE: Following are the duties performed by employees in this classification. However, employees may perform other related duties at an equivalent level. Not all duties listed are necessarily performed by each individual in the classification.


1\. Coordinates patient care activities in partnership with other members of the healthcare team, the patient, the patient’s representatives, and community partners; makes referrals as appropriate.


2\. Completes screening and assessments to determine patient’s health and psychosocial barriers to care and wellness needs. Communicates results to healthcare team, as necessary.


3\. Creates, implements and maintains care plan based on assessments.


4\. Prepares case reports; documents assessment, progress notes and related information as required by Medicare, MediCal, Title 22 and other mandated regulations according to Department standards; prepares correspondence regarding patient intake or follow\-up and documents in the EHR.


5\. Identifies and coordinates referrals and linkage between patients and families to community resources that will assist them in achieving positive health outcomes; may contact agencies/community\-based organizations on patients’ behalf.


6\. Educates team and allied service providers about community needs and perspectives.


7\. Engages patients in home and community environments, as needed.


8\. Encourages access to appropriate care, and self\-management strategies through strengths\-based health coaching and navigation support.


9\. Mediates barriers impairing patients’ ability to manage wellness and supports adherence to health improvement or treatment plan.


10\. Enrolls patient in ADAP on an annual basis, or as needed (Adult Immunology Clinic)


11\. Conducts HIV testing and counseling at community events as needed (Adult Immunology Clinic)


12\. Coordinates repair, emission checks and service activities and maintains records of vehicle maintenance, equipment and operating expenses. Drives and operates the mobile health van to field sites (i.e. shelters, parks and meal sites) on a scheduled basis. Ensures the van is maintained/cleaned and vehicle maintenance and housekeeping logs are kept current. (Mobile Health Clinic)


13\. Completes Bedside assessments in a manner that is friendly, helpful, informative and supports their participation in medical care. (required for certain positions)


14\. Partners with patients during in\-person warm hand\-offs from medical and allied providers to provide in immediate needs assessment and initial provision of resources (required for certain positions)


15\. Performs other duties as assigned.


**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**:  

Required Education: High School Diploma or equivalent.


Required Experience: One year’s experience in a public sector or health care service capacity, performing duties such as direct patient outreach, care coordination and linkage to community resources.


Preferred Experience: Individual history that aligns with and provides a connection to community or population being served.


Required Licenses/Certifications: Must be eligible to sign self\-attestation of lived experience, as defined by California Department of Healthcare Services (DHCS): CHWs must have lived experience that aligns with and provides a connection between the CHW and the community or population being served. This may include, but is not limited to, lived experience related to incarceration, military service, pregnancy and birth, disability, foster system placement, homelessness, mental health conditions or substance use, or being a survivor of domestic or intimate partner violence or abuse and exploitation. Lived experience may also include shared race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, language, or cultural background of one or more linguistic, cultural, or other groups in the community for which the CHW is providing services.


Preferred Licenses/Certifications: Community Health Worker certification; Emergency Technician certification. ADAP, HIV testing/Counseling certification


Required Experience: Minimum 20 hours of driving experience of large vehicles in excess of 15 ft. (Mobile Health Department)


Required Experience: Knowledge of HIV services in Alameda County, and competence in cultural differences, HIV/AIDS, minority health, sexual practices, and a demonstrated competence in working with people who use substances, Black/AA, Indigenous and other people of color, LGBT, and youth communities. (AIC Clinic)


Required Licenses/Certifications: Valid California Class C driver’s license and good driving record. (certain positions only)


Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills, and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

  


PAY RANGE: $41\.34 \- $50\.25/ per hour  

*The pay range for this position reflects the base pay scale for the role at Alameda Health System. Final compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to a candidate’s experience, education, skills, licenses and certifications, departmental equity, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and the operational needs of the organization. Alameda Health System also offers eligible positions a generous comprehensive benefits program.*

  


Location: Alameda Health System · HEALTH ADVOCATES  

Schedule: Full Time, Day

***LOCATION:*** *Pleasanton, CA\|* *Diversion Triage Center*  

***Employment Type:*** Full\-time  

  

**Who are we?**  

Horizon Services, Inc. (HSI) is a nonprofit established in 1974 which offers addiction treatment with the goal of reducing substance use related challenges for people from all walks of life, including those from some of the most disenfranchised and marginalized communities. Providing exceptional services to our diverse community. We are proud to support Behavioral Health Services Department (BHSD) clients in their preferred languages, ensuring accessibility and inclusivity for all.  

We practice our values of Integrity, Respect, Compassion, and Professionalism to provide residential treatment, withdrawal management, and sobering programs to support the well\-being of women, men, youth, LGBTQ, and BIPOC clients to live healthy, fulfilling and constructive lives. HSI is an inclusive workplace and a learning community where our collective experiences enrich each other’s growth.  

The case manager is responsible for case management and referral planning for clients in the Triage Center suffering from substance use, mental health, or co\-occurring disorders. Duties include care coordination, maintaining positive working relationships with outside community providers, scheduling appointments, arranging transportation, providing transportation, assisting with acquiring medications, ongoing care and discharge planning, and crisis intervention. The case manager will collaborate with Program Manager, Nurse Prescriber, Peer Specialist, and MH Case Manager to ensure clients basic needs are being met in preparation for stabilization and discharge planning.  

  

**How can you make a difference in people’s lives?**  

  

We are seeking a Case Manager who is passionate about serving diverse communities. Bilingual candidates fluent in one or more of BHSD’s five threshold languages—Chinese, Spanish, Tagalog, or Vietnamese—are eligible for an additional incentive.  

  

In this role, you’ll make a difference in the lives of people with substance abuse challenges, and often with co\-occurring conditions. You’ll use and grow your skills in compassionate care, crisis intervention and de\-escalation, in a supportive and inclusive work environment. You’ll have the opportunity to provide our community with substance abuse treatment to help people who are just discovering possibilities in their journey, going from a place of hopelessness to a place where they are valued and have the potential for a better life.

* Provide case management services to clients at Access Triage Center.
