jobs.title: Member Support Specialist (Strawberry Village)
jobs.description:
**About Us**



One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn't your average doctor's office. We're on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved \- from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in\-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on\-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.



In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we're building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.


**The Opportunity**



As a Member Support Specialist (Administrative Assistant) you will be an ambassador for patients in office, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in\-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for patient feedback, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or in office providers.



You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer\-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self\-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.



What you'll likely work on:


* Use impeccable C\-I\-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions and ensure a fluid and positive in\-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary
* All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc
* Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.
* Master our technology suite including but not limited to Slack, G\-suite, Zoom, and our Electronic Medical Record System 1Life, in order to interact with team members and patients and complete daily work
* Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization


These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.



What you'll need:


* At least 1 year of experience in high touch customer or patient facing roles
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Experience working on collaborative, diverse and feedback\-driven multi\-disciplinary teams
* A proven track record of persisting through change, demonstrating a forward thinking perspective when under pressure, and consistently stepping up to take action on challenges
* Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously
* Competitive salary: $24\.00 per hour


This is a full\-time role 40 hours per week (8 hour shifts per day) based in\-person with our team and patients at offices in Strawberry Village in Mill Valley from Monday\-Saturday between 7:30 AM and 6:00 PM PST. The base pay for this position is $24\.00 per hour based on a full time schedule, with a 1\.25 differential for eligible extended hours.



Physical Demands: Mostly sedentary work duties require exerting up to ten pounds of force occasionally and/or small amounts of force frequently. Sedentary work typically involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods.

**One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness. All regular team members working 24\+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:**



Taking care of you today


* Paid sabbatical for every five years of service
* Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family
* Employee Assistance Program \- Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues
* Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
* Pre\-Tax commuter benefits
* PTO cash outs \- Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year


Protecting your future for you and your family


* 401K match
* Credit towards emergency childcare
* Company paid maternity and paternity leave
* Paid Life Insurance \- One Medical pays 100%

**About Cleerly**



We're Cleerly – a healthcare company that's revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world's leading cardiologists and are a growing team of world\-class engineering, operations, medical affairs, marketing, and sales leaders. We raised $223M in Series C funding in 2022 which has enabled rapid growth and continued support of our mission. In December 2024 we received an additional $106M in a Series C extension funding. jobs.title: Pricing Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
* Sunnyvale, CA, United States
* Not Remote
* Finance \& Accounting
* JOB218596


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position:**


We are seeking a process\-oriented Pricing Operations Analyst to support how pricing reaches the customer: the global price books that carry it, the contracted pricing that governs it, and the Configure Price Quote (CPQ) system that executes it.


Pricing operations is where commercial strategy becomes real. This role designs the processes and system logic that make quoting accurate, fast, and simple for the sales teams and customers who depend on it, and serves as the practical expert on what can be delivered within existing system constraints: what is achievable, in what sequence, and at what operational cost.


Partnering with regional pricing, Sales Operations, Contracts, Customer Service, Product Management, and Systems teams, the Analyst will create excellence in the transaction experience, quoting process, and pricing fidelity across the quote\-to\-cash continuum. Success in this role is measured less by analysis produced than by how reliably price is executed worldwide.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**


**Price Book Management**


* Support creation and maintenance of global price books, including new product introductions, list price changes, regional variants, effective dating, and ongoing accuracy.
* Drive the pricing release calendar, coordinating change windows with commercial, regional, and systems stakeholders.

**Contract\-Based Pricing**


* Activate and maintain contracted, deviated, and tiered customer pricing in CPQ and ERP, including GPO and IDN agreement terms, membership eligibility, and price expiration tracking.
* Research and resolve price discrepancies across quote, order, and invoice, correcting the underlying system condition rather than the individual transaction.
* Support the discount approval process for local commercial leader price decisions.

**Systems and Configuration**


* Configure and maintain CPQ pricing logic, discounting rules, and approval workflows.
* Perform regression testing of pricing logic following each system change or price book release.
* Partner with Systems and IT on CPQ build, enhancement scoping, and defect resolution.

**Process Design and Optimization**


* Design, document, and improve repeatable price execution processes, removing friction across the quote\-to\-cash continuum.
* Evaluate trade\-offs between process change and system change, and recommend the approach that delivers the outcome soonest at acceptable operational cost.

**Enablement and Customer Experience**


* Train and enable sales, sales operations, and regional pricing teams on quoting and price execution, acting as the first point of contact for how\-to questions.
* Improve the quoting and purchasing experience for sales teams and customers, treating both as the customer of this function.

**Controls and Reporting**


* Maintain controls and audit\-ready documentation for all price book and contract pricing changes.
* Report on price execution accuracy and quoting cycle time, and act on the trends that surface.

### **Qualifications**


**Required Skills and Experience:**


* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in pricing operations, sales operations, order management, contract administration, or business process roles, including a minimum of 2 years of hands\-on CPQ configuration.
* Hands\-on configuration experience with a CPQ platform, including pricing rules and approval workflows.
* Direct experience administering contracted or deviated customer pricing.
* Demonstrated process design and process mapping capability, with clear written documentation.
* Attention to detail and accuracy when working with high\-volume pricing data.
* Ability to identify workable solutions inside a fixed system, and to explain trade\-offs between process change and system change to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Service orientation toward internal partners and external customers.
* Advanced Excel skills, with working knowledge of Tableau.
* Strong collaborator across time zones and functions, with a focus on process integration and optimization.
* This role requires approximately 10% travel, including international travel.
* This role requires working onsite in our Sunnyvale, CA office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday every week.

**Required Education and Training**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field

**Preferred Skills and Experience**


* Background in or familiarity with the healthcare industry, medical devices, and hospital operations.
* Familiarity with GPO and IDN contract structures and healthcare contract administration.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP or a comparable ERP system, and ownership of price books or comparable master data.
* Experience applying generative AI tools to process automation and documentation.

jobs.title: Business Operations & Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
**Group 1001** is a consumer\-centric, technology\-driven family of insurance companies on a mission to deliver outstanding value and operational performance by combining financial strength and stability with deep insurance expertise and a can\-do culture. Group1001’s culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, communication, core business focus, risk management, and striving for outcomes. This goal extends to how we hire and onboard our most valuable assets – our employees.

**Company Overview:**

**Gainbridge,**a part of the Group 1001 enterprise, is a self\-managed, innovative, digital platform providing its clients with direct access to trusted financial products to smartly grow their savings over time. Gainbridge strives to offer products through its platform that are simple, intuitive, and backed by smart technology with no complexity or hidden fees. Gainbridge empowers clients to take control of the financial future with simple solutions that are accessible to everyone no matter their budget.

**Why This Role Matters:**


The Business Operations Manager will own and evolve the operating system of Gainbridge. This is a high\-visibility, high\-trust role that sits at the intersection of strategy, process, and execution, partnering directly with senior leadership to build the rhythms, standards, and infrastructure that enable the business to scale. You will be accountable for a broad portfolio spanning the annual planning cycle, governance cadences, vendor operations, knowledge management, and company\-wide coordination mechanisms, and you will be the person Gainbridge turns to when a high\-stakes initiative needs someone to own it end\-to\-end, across teams that don't report to you.


If you thrive in ambiguity, are energized by making an entire organization run better, and can hold both strategic design and operational detail simultaneously, this role was built for you.

**How You'll Contribute:**

**Annual Planning Cycle \& Operating Cadence**

* **Own the company's Annual Planning Cycle** from kickoff to completion, ensuring strategic priorities are translated into actionable operating plans across all teams.
* **Run the business operating cadence** (monthly performance reviews, bi\-monthly all\-hands, quarterly GAB prep) — scheduling, agendas, pre\-reads, and notes.
* **Develop and manage the annual Operational Plan,** tracking OKR progress against business priorities and surfacing risks to leadership in a timely manner.
* **Partner with the AVP, Strategy on the monthly Standard Update,** gathering, validating, and structuring the underlying data (Scorecard, TAC, MAC, COF, NPS, premium run rate) that anchors the narrative to leadership and the Gainbridge Advisory Board.
* **Lead QBR (Quarterly Business Review) company meetings** that drive accountability and informed decision\-making, creating a shared understanding of where we are.
* **Implement and update workflow processes** **across teams to improve efficiency and reduce friction.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Key Vendor Management**
-------------------------

* **Lead the Gainbridge Vendor Management Program:** onboarding, payment and budget tracking, invoice routing, PO/request tracking, contract renewal, and performance scorecards, all in partnership with Sourcing, Finance, IT, and Legal.
* **Mastery of why we use a vendor**: what key activities are the vendors supporting? Are they competitively priced? Should we consider a new tool?

**Risk, Compliance \& Infrastructure**

* **Own the Business Continuity planning process (BIA / BCP),** identifying and documenting Critical Business Processes and ensuring plans are current and actionable.
* **Own the Legal Compliance Workflow,** ensuring regulatory obligations are tracked, assigned, and met on time.

**Cross\-Functional Program Leadership**

* **Own end\-to\-end delivery of Gainbridge's highest\-stakes cross\-functional initiatives,** from initial scoping and success criteria through launch. These projects are the kind of work that touches Product, Engineering, Marketing, Compliance, and Ops, etc., simultaneously.
* **Create project management company norms** that are well\-established, easy to follow, and value\-creating for leading projects across the company. This creates a common language and muscle memory for how the team interacts with a project, even when you are not the initiative's leader.
* **Build the scaffolding that keeps complex initiatives on track:** a clear scope, a sequenced timeline with real dependencies mapped across teams, and a living risk\-and\-issues log that surfaces problems before they become blockers.
* **Drive decisions to closure, not just track status:** You are a thought partner that runs the cadence of check\-ins, name the trade\-offs, and force the conversation when an initiative is drifting, or a decision is stuck.
* **Hold contributors accountable to timelines and commitments** without formal authority and through clarity, credibility, and relentless follow\-through rather than positional power.
* **Translate program status into clear, leadership\-ready updates** that separate signal from noise for executive stakeholders.

**Company Meeting System \& Communication Norms**

* **Own the company\-wide meeting system** and communication/documentation norms; each department runs its own meeting rhythms within that framework.
* **Maintain company\-wide communication and documentation norms** that support a high\-performing team.
* **Maintain the Significant Events \& Milestone Calendar** as a single source of truth for major events, board dates, town halls, offsites, product launches, and key milestones across the company.

**Knowledge Management \& Version Control**

* **Own the company's Confluence space,** including governance conventions, version control standards, and ensuring the latest board decks, narratives, scorecards, and executive communications

jobs.title: Compliance & Regulatory Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Candiid Labs is an engineering studio operating a portfolio of production platforms in regulated industries. Our flagship product, Connexx, is a HIPAA\-compliant clinical platform serving behavioral health, developmental disability services, home health, and general practice providers. We are early\-stage, growing quickly, and currently onboarding enterprise customers in multiple states.

Our team is small, senior, and distributed. We hire people who can own their function without daily supervision, who write clearly, and who are honest about what they know and don't know.

Why We Are Hiring for This Role

As Connexx grows across new states, the compliance and regulatory work required to operate legitimately in each jurisdiction is expanding faster than the founder can personally manage. HIPAA program maintenance, state\-specific behavioral health regulations, payer\-specific compliance requirements, Business Associate Agreement reviews, subprocessor compliance oversight, and compliance\-related customer questions have grown into a full function that needs a dedicated owner.

You will be the first dedicated compliance hire at Candiid Labs. This is substantive work with real ownership. You will not be doing generic administrative tasks. You will be running the compliance function.

What You Will Own

HIPAA Program Management

* Maintain our written HIPAA policies and procedures across Privacy Rule, Security Rule, and Breach Notification Rule requirements
* Coordinate annual HIPAA Security Risk Assessment updates
* Manage workforce HIPAA training tracking and documentation
* Own the compliance evidence library for customer due diligence responses

Business Associate Agreement (BAA) Management

* Review incoming BAAs from customers, redlining against our standard positions
* Maintain BAAs with all subprocessors (cloud providers, AI providers, communication vendors)
* Maintain the master BAA registry with expiration and renewal tracking

State\-Specific Regulatory Work

* Build and maintain compliance maps for each state we operate in
* Own the research and documentation for each new state entry as Connexx expands
* Track and interpret changes to state behavioral health, home health, and developmental disability regulations affecting our customers

Payer\-Specific Compliance

* Document billing rules, encounter data requirements, and audit expectations for each Medicaid Managed Care Organization our customers work with
* Maintain compliance references for state\-specific data submission systems

Customer\-Facing Compliance Artifacts

* Draft compliance sections of proposals, capabilities briefings, and enterprise sales materials
* Respond to customer security questionnaires
* Prepare responses to auditor requests

Subprocessor Oversight

* Maintain the list of subprocessors touching customer data
* Verify each subprocessor has current BAA, active security posture, and documented compliance status
* Onboard new subprocessors through a compliance review before engagement

Breach Preparedness and Response

* Maintain the incident response plan and breach notification procedures
* Coordinate breach response if an incident occurs (final breach determination and notification decisions escalate to CEO and external counsel)

Documentation and Evidence

* Maintain the compliance evidence library
* Prepare materials for customer audits, SOC 2 readiness work, and future federal engagements

What We Are Looking For

Required

* 4\+ years of experience in healthcare compliance, healthcare regulatory work, or a closely related function
* Prior direct exposure to US healthcare compliance environments (through work at a healthcare organization, healthcare vendor, consulting firm serving health systems, remote employment with a healthcare company, or similar path)
* Working knowledge of HIPAA (Privacy Rule, Security Rule, Breach Notification Rule) that goes beyond having read the regulations. You should be able to explain how HIPAA applies to specific operational situations.
* Strong written English, particularly the ability to draft compliance policies, BAA redlines, and customer\-facing compliance responses that read professionally to enterprise buyers
* Ability to work independently and own a function without daily supervision
* Comfort with US Eastern time zone

Strongly Preferred

* Prior experience with behavioral health, mental health, or developmental disability services compliance specifically
* Familiarity with state\-level healthcare regulations
* Experience reviewing and negotiating BAAs
* Familiarity with 42 CFR Part 2 (federal substance use disorder record confidentiality)
* Prior work with health plan or Medicaid Managed Care Organization compliance requirements
* SOC 2 readiness or audit experience

Nice to Have

* Certifications: CHC (Certified in Healthcare Compliance), CHPC (Certified in Healthcare Privacy Compliance), CIPP/US, HCCA membership
* Experience with AI\-specific healthcare compliance (LLM providers, PHI in AI contexts)

What We Are Not Looking For

* Generic HR or administrative professionals looking to move into compliance
* Compliance generalists without healthcare\-specific experience
* Candidates who overstate their experience. We will verify through interviews and references. Please represent your background accurately. We would rather hire someone at a slightly junior level who represents themselves honestly than someone at a senior level who cannot answer specific questions in interview.

Compensation and Engagement Terms

* Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. We will discuss compensation openly during the interview process.
* Annual compensation review with performance\-based increases
* Direct working relationship with the founder and CEO of a growing company; substantial career development opportunity
* Path to expanded role and scope as Connexx grows

How to Apply

Send an email to: janet@candiid.io

V2 Strategic Advisors is where velocity meets voltage \- a boutique management and technology consulting firm that has spent 20\+ years transforming media and advertising sales organizations. Our edge? We offer a rare blend of management consulting, data, analytics, AI, and systems integration \- all under one roof, powered by best\-in\-class platforms including Salesforce, Databricks, Snowflake, HubSpot, and leading AI platforms like Claude and Gemini. We're scaling our internal operations to match our growing market footprint, and we need a sharp, hands\-on **Management \& Technology Consulting Operations Manager** to own it.



This isn't a support role. You'll be a proactive, hands\-on partner to our VP of Operations and our IT Manager, driving V2's internal operations end\-to\-end. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, High Volume Recruiting
jobs.description:
Included Health is seeking a Senior Program Manager, High Volume Recruiting, to build and run the operating system for our highest\-volume hiring areas, initially Clinical, Behavioral Health and Member Care.



This role will create consistent operating cadence across high\-volume pods, improve funnel performance, manage agency and vendor effectiveness, and expand the use of automation and AI\-enabled workflows. The PM will translate hiring goals into capacity plans, identify risks early, and drive corrective action across the recruiting machine.



This is not a traditional recruiting coordinator or status\-reporting role. The successful candidate will operate as a program owner: diagnosing problems, recommending solutions, and holding cross\-functional partners accountable for measurable outcomes.



### **Responsibilities:**


### **High\-Volume Operating Model**


* Build and maintain a standardized operating model across high\-volume recruiting pods.
* Establish operating cadences, planning processes, scorecards, and escalation paths.
* Translate hiring goals into funnel requirements, capacity plans, and execution priorities.
* Maintain a consolidated view of hiring health, risks, dependencies, and corrective actions.
* Partner with pod owners to improve pacing, stakeholder readiness, funnel quality, and delivery against goals.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and scale the high\-volume model across additional hiring areas.

### **Agency and Vendor Management**


* Own day\-to\-day operating performance for high\-volume agency and vendor partners.
* Establish clear expectations and scorecards covering submissions, quality, fill rate, time\-to\-fill, pricing, responsiveness, and corrective action.
* Create a consistent process for agency onboarding, performance reviews, escalation, and offboarding.
* Shift routine agency management and reporting away from senior leaders and toward exception\-based escalation.

**Automation and AI\-Enabled Recruiting**
* Expand BrightHire, AI interviewer, and related workflow adoption across high\-volume recruiting.
* Partner with Talent Operations on workflow design, tooling, and automation opportunities.
* Automate reporting, funnel tracking, quality monitoring, and partner performance visibility.
* Identify friction points and run targeted process\-improvement pilots.
* Measure the impact of automation through recruiter hours saved, funnel conversion, time\-to\-fill, quality, and candidate experience.

### **Reporting and Decision Support**

Versar is seeking a full\-time Project Manager (PM) to support physical Electronic Security System (ESS) installation projects nationwide in support of the United States Marshals Service (USMS). The ideal candidate will be self\-motivated with the ability to work independently with some oversite. Additionally, the candidate must have experience with the performance and supervision of tasks related to electronic security systems (i.e., Access Control, CCTV, Video Management, Intrusion Detection, Intercoms etc.), and in managing the performance of projects, including people, schedule, scope, quality control, and budget. The PM will be the senior subject matter expert and monitor, control and report status on cost, schedule and performance.

* Provide overall management of multiple projects mainly on customer sites with some availability for remote work. Extensive travel will be required around the project schedules.

* Manage internal resources and subcontractors. This includes, but is not limited to, verifying quality of installation and deliverables, evaluating percent complete for subcontracted tasks, evaluating equipment and materials used to ensure compliance with contractual requirements and standards, validating invoices for payment, negotiating costs, and managing scope change.
* Ensure contractual compliance with all installation activities, deliverables, and schedule.
* Manage and document inventory of all equipment and material purchased for the project and/or shipped to the project site for installation.
* Ensure internal project management procedures are followed, including project revenue forecasting and estimate at completion.
* Ensure all projects are carried out safely in accordance with Versar’s safety requirements.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 3\-5 years of verifiable project management experience.
* Proficiency with MS Office programs, including Word, Excel, and Project.
* Professional experience in the systems administration field with three years of overall experience in Microsoft Windows client and server operating systems.
* Certifications, or have the capability to obtain certifications, in Hirsch, Bosch BVMS, and Bosch IDS, and experience with Commend, Aiphone, Inovonics, and networks.

jobs.title: Facilities Project Coordinator (Pacific Time Zone)
jobs.description:
\[solidcore] is looking for a Facilities Project Coordinator to join our team to support our studios. Our ideal team member is empathetic, strategic, mission driven, puts people first and fosters a safe, welcoming and FUN work environment. Reporting directly to the Senior Facilities Field Manager, the Facilities Project Coordinator is responsible for supporting the daily maintenance/upkeep of the studios through work queue management.



This position will be fully remote, with the ideal candidate residing in the Pacific Time Zone and the capability to travel to our Arlington, VA headquarters as needed.



### **Responsibilities:**


* Coordinate and track multiple facilities projects simultaneously from initiation through completion
* Manage a high volume of work orders across varying priority levels, ensuring timely responses and resolution by internal teams and vendors.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between internal teams, vendors, and building management
* Communicate project timelines and expectations to field and regional teams
* Solicit, review, and manage vendor bids and proposals
* Issue and manage work orders through our CMMS, FEXA
* Coordinate contractor site access, scheduling, and on\-site activity
* Ensure vendors meet compliance, insurance, and safety requirements
* Coordinate with studio field teams to minimize disruption during project execution
* Enter and update project data in FEXA
* Serve as on\-call point of contact for studio teams up to twice per month
* Ad hoc projects (ex. document overall review of vendor performance, rollout new vendor pilots across field teams)
* Support other Facilities Project Coordinators that are out of office
### **What skills you'll bring to us:**


* A self\-starter who takes ownership of their work, drives tasks forward independently, and proactively identifies what needs to be done without waiting to be asked.
* Able to identify problems, work though solutions, and connect the dots across departments. Balances big\-picture thinking with attention to detail.
* Processes complex information and communicates it clearly and concisely to the right people at the right time.
* Understands that everyone is working toward the same goal. Willing to pitch in, celebrate teammates’ wins, and support others when needed.
* Able to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously, staying organized and effective in a fast\-paced, high volume environment.
* Approaches feedback and challenges with professionalism and a growth mindset, using setbacks as opportunities to improve.
* Builds and maintains systems that keep projects, communications, and documentation easy to track and retrieve. Highly detail\-oriented with strong file management and record\-keeping habits that hold up under a high volume of concurrent work.
### **It will be helpful if you possess the following:**


* 2\+ years of experience in facilities coordination, vendor management, or multi\-site operations.
* Aptitude for prioritizing multiple projects.
* A ‘can do’ spirit and positive attitude.
### **Compensation and Benefits:**


* Compensation Range: $20\.25\-26\.50 per hour, location dependent
* Bonus eligibility based on performance
* 401k with employer match
* Health, dental, \& vision insurance
* Flexible PTO
* Free drop in classes at \[solidcore]
* And MORE
\[solidcore] is a national boutique fitness company with 100\+ studios across the country. Our signature workout is 50 minutes of low\-impact, high\-intensity strength training: the lights are low and the music is loud. The coach guides the class through a series of slow \& controlled movements that are sequenced to work muscles to failure. This class is accessible for all fitness levels and can be amplified or modified to accommodate individual goals. Class is as intense as our reviews suggest, but our instructors go above and beyond to provide a welcoming, supportive, empowering, and challenging experience for all. Please visit our website here to read more about our mission.  

\[solidcore] is firmly committed to social justice and promoting a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. You can click here to find out more about the actions we are taking to promote a more diverse and inclusive space for both our clients and our internal team.  

\[solidcore] is an equal\-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. \[solidcore] makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

jobs.title: Site Quality Manager - Gas Power Generation
jobs.description:
Blattner is expanding our energy construction leadership into gas power generation. This is a unique opportunity to help build this new business from the ground up, backed by a company with decades of proven success in the energy sector. This position will help us shape the processes and standards that carry this business forward to deliver end\-to\-end hybrid energy solutions.


The Site Quality Manager is a champion of Blattner’s quality culture and verifies that Blattner’s Quality Program is being delivered by the project teams. They serve as a technical subject matter expert and technical consultant, supporting the Site Quality Coordinators and Quality department overall. They mentor Site Quality Coordinators on technical knowledge, inspection and testing methodologies, management and coaching of Quality Control Inspectors, as well as engagement techniques that strengthens the quality culture at the project level. These engagement techniques are applicable to interactions with Blattner construction personnel, as well as Client representatives.

**A DAY IN THE LIFE**

* Assesses Blattner’s Quality Culture and verifies that Blattner’s Quality Program is understood, followed, enforced, and consistently applied across projects to ensure project teams deliver a quality project in a safe and efficient manner.
* Acts as the subject matter expert with the development, implementation, and continued refinement of Inspection Instructions and Test Instructions, while collaborating with the General Superintendents Construction and Quality Department during these efforts.
* Trains, develops, and mentors Site Quality Coordinators to ensure the Quality Control team is integrated as a part of the project team, creating, and sustaining a proactive quality culture.
* Supports Site Quality Coordinators in establishing accurate and efficient Quality Control Work Plans for each project.
* Assists site management in the training and coaching of Construction personnel as it relates to Quality Assurance efforts, analyzing trends, and problem solving to proactively mitigate quality, safety, and waste exposures.
* Promotes the expectation that all employees operate in accordance with Standard Work Instructions and mandatory operating procedures.
* Engages with the Process Excellence team, acting as the Quality subject matter expert, when updates are required for Standard Work documents.
* Collaborates with Safety to ensure Quality Control teams are carrying out their responsibilities with regards to the corporate safety program, electrical safety program, and project specific safety policies.
* Applies Stop Work Authority for quality and/or safety exposures observed, as applicable.
* Collaborates with General Superintendents Construction and project teams to ensure Quality Control teams are aligned to support all Quality Control inspection and testing requirements.
* Assists with the recruitment of Site Quality Coordinators and Quality Control Inspectors by participating in the interview and hiring process.
* Supports the Quality department with the management of scheduling and placement of site Quality personnel.
* Communicates and advises Project teams on company\-wide quality challenges and concerns.
* Performs observations on construction and quality activities to ensure the Quality Program is being followed and acts when deviations are identified.
* Supports data driven Continuous Improvement initiatives to ensure Quality opportunities are captured.

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**

* Bachelor’s degree in management, construction management, engineering, quality, or related field or equivalent education and experience.
* Eight or more years of progressive related experience required. Experience in a construction quality leadership preferred.
* Excellent communication and people skills, as well as interpersonal and collaborative skills at all levels within the organization and clients.
* Must be able to articulate clear and concise messages including translating technical material when necessary.
* Must possess the leadership skills and experience necessary to train and develop Site Quality Coordinators.
* Must have a complete understanding of Standard Work including Lessons Learned, Work Methods, Standard Work Instructions.
* Must have complete understanding of Quality Control Inspection Instructions and Test Instructions.
* Must have a thorough understanding of root cause analysis techniques, nonconformance reporting, management, and data reporting.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications, as well as OEM manuals.
* Ability to quickly develop/obtain knowledge of renewable energy construction methods, engineering, and equipment and material selection.
* Acts as a leader in a group of peers and/or subordinates. Must be capable of orchestrating necessary conversations, meetings, presentations, etc.
* Competent with computer programs (MS Office) and analytical tools.
* Ability to maintain an acceptable driving record.
* Up to 75% travel required.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU**

* Competitive pay and annual bonus
* Reimbursed lodging
* Per diem
* Company truck with a gas card
* Rotational program with paid flights home
* 100% employer\-paid health insurance premiums for employees
* 100% employer\-paid dental insurance premiums for everyone on plan
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off (PTO)
* Education assistance (tuition reimbursement)
* Employee/family focused culture
* And more!

**WHO ARE WE?**


Blattner Company is a leading renewable energy contractor and service provider with utility scale wind, solar, and energy storage projects across the United States. Based at our headquarters in Avon, Minnesota, we are powered by over a century of construction experience and passionate, innovative employees.


Be a part of something bigger and join the Blattner team – Leading America to a clean energy future!

jobs.title: Patient Navigator - part time
jobs.description:
At Curana Health, we're on a mission to radically improve the health, happiness, and dignity of older adults—and we're looking for passionate people to help us do it.  

As a national leader in value\-based care, we offer senior living communities and skilled nursing facilities a wide range of solutions (including on\-site primary care services, Accountable Care Organizations, and Medicare Advantage Special Needs Plans) proven to enhance health outcomes, streamline operations, and create new financial opportunities.  

Founded in 2021, we've grown quickly—now serving 200,000\+ seniors in 1,500\+ communities across 32 states. Our team includes more than 1,000 clinicians alongside care coordinators, analysts, operators, and professionals from all backgrounds, all working together to deliver high\-quality, proactive solutions for senior living operators and those they care for.  

Ranked \#147 on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest\-growing private companies, we're just getting started. If you're looking to make a meaningful impact on the senior healthcare landscape, you're in the right place—and we look forward to working with you.  

For more information about our company, visit CuranaHealth.com.
**Summary**
-----------



The Patient Navigator serves as the first point of contact for patients, managing incoming calls with professionalism and compassion. In this role, the Navigator conducts phone\-based assessments to gather medical history and symptoms, evaluates the urgency of patient concerns, and guides individuals to the most appropriate level of care or department. This position also plays a key communication role by relaying information between patients and healthcare teams to ensure coordinated, seamless care across the health network.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------



Patient Interaction


* Answer and manage incoming calls in a professional and courteous manner.
* Greet patients warmly and assist them with inquiries or direct them to the appropriate department.

Patient Assessment


* Conduct a thorough assessment of patients’ health concerns over the phone.
* Gather relevant medical history, symptoms, and other pertinent information to determine the urgency and nature of the medical issue.
* Determine the appropriate level of care needed and guide patients to the most suitable healthcare resources.

Communication


* Relay messages and information between patients and healthcare teams
* Collaborate with other staff members to ensure seamless communication within our health network.
**Qualifications**
------------------


* High School Diploma or equivalent
* Exceptional customer service skills
* Organized and effective communicator
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
* Proficient in using computer systems and electronic health records.
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Previous experience in a medical office or healthcare setting is preferred.
* Team player with a positive attitude

  

We’re thrilled to announce that Curana Health has been named the 147th fastest growing, privately owned company in the nation on Inc. magazine’s prestigious Inc. 5000 list. Curana also ranked 16th in the “Healthcare \& Medical” industry category and 21st in Texas.  

  

This recognition underscores Curana Health’s impact in transforming senior housing by supporting operator stability and ensuring seniors receive the high\-quality care they deserve.

jobs.title: Contact Center Team Lead
jobs.description:
About Us:

Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility\-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data\-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.* **Come Join Our Team!**
	+ As part of our robust Rewards \& Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance\-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards.
* **Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**


Job Summary:
* The **Contact Center Team Lead** serves as a senior member of the Contact Center team and acts as the first line of support for Contact Center Specialists. This role assists Supervisors with day\-to\-day operations, training, and escalations while maintaining active participation in patient support activities. The Lead supports service delivery by resolving complex issues, mentoring peers, monitoring queue performance, and promoting adherence to quality and productivity standards.

  

The Contact Center Team Lead balances leadership responsibilities with hands\-on operational duties and is expected to spend at least 50% of their time actively answering calls and assisting patients to ensure service level goals and frontline expertise are maintained. This role provides operational direction and support to Contact Center Specialists but does not have formal supervisory authority.
Essential Functions and Tasks:
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on contact center systems, processes, and workflows.
* Support Supervisors by handling escalated calls, emails, and complex inquiries requiring advanced problem\-solving or cross\-department collaboration.
* Provide real\-time guidance and support to Contact Center Specialists to ensure accuracy, empathy, and adherence to quality and compliance standards.
* Conduct peer mentoring, side\-by\-side coaching, and participate in quality calibration sessions to ensure consistency in performance expectations.
* Assist Supervisors with onboarding, refresher training, and the communication of new policies, procedures, and system updates.
* Monitor call queues, service levels, and productivity dashboards; proactively identify performance trends or workflow issues and communicate findings to leadership.
* Perform call audits and quality checks, providing feedback and actionable recommendations for improvement.
* Compile and prepare reports or data summaries related to call volumes, service levels, and quality performance as requested.
* Participate in process improvement efforts, contribute feedback and help develop new procedures to improve efficiency and patient satisfaction.
* Collaborate with departments such as Quality Assurance, Training, and Workforce Management to address barriers impacting performance or patient experience.
* Act as a positive role model and resource for peers, fostering teamwork, professionalism, and accountability.
* Uphold confidentiality and compliance standards in accordance with company policy and applicable regulations.
* Perform special projects and other duties as assigned.


Education and Experience Requirements:
* Associate’s degree (2 years) required; bachelor’s degree in business, Healthcare, or related field preferred.
* Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in a healthcare contact center or similar high\-volume customer service environment.
* Prior experience serving as a senior agent, team lead or mentor preferred.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
* Fluency in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Deep understanding of patient billing, insurance processes, and Explanation of Benefits (EOBs).
* Demonstrated ability to handle escalated calls with empathy, professionalism, and accuracy.
* Proficiency with contact center technologies, CRMs, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to coach and mentor peers effectively.
* Excellent organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining a positive, professional demeanor.
* Flexibility to adapt to evolving business needs and process improvements.


Compensation:
* Base Compensation will be based on various factors unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job\-related reasons.
* This position is also eligible for a discretionary incentive bonus in accordance with company policies.


Ventra Health:

jobs.title: Case Manager - NLC
jobs.description:
**FIND YOUR FUTURE**
====================


We're excited about the potential people bring to our organization. You can grow your career here while enjoying first\-class perks, benefits and a culture that fosters growth, innovation and collaboration.

**Overview**
============


The Case Manager will be responsible for applying the six essential activities of case management which include assessment, planning, implementation, coordination, monitoring and evaluation with the core components through the administration of quality improvement functions (process, relationships, health care management, community resources and support, service delivery and psychosocial intervention).

**Qualifications**
==================

* Registered Nurse (RN) with active, current, unrestricted license in a Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) state required. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Case Management Certification (CCM) required. Candidates without CCM certification are required to obtain it within three (3\) years of commencing employment.
* Three (3\) years of clinical RN experience in a med/surg or ambulatory care setting required. Clinical experience in at least one of the following areas preferred: Behavior Health, Transplant, Neo\-Natal or Oncology.
* Previous experience in managed care a plus.
* Clinical knowledge of the health or social work needs for the population served.
* Ability to identify barriers to a successful care management path.
* Ability to interact effectively with physicians and other members of the health care team.
* Excellent problem\-solving abilities, coupled with solid time management skills.
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
* Transferable knowledge, skill and ability to complete job duties independently and proficiently. Flexibility in work schedules and assignments.
* Proven examples of displaying Nova’s Core 4: Act with Passion, Work Together, Be Accountable, Build Trust.

**Essential Accountabilities**
==============================

* Assess the patient’s broad spectrum of immediate and long\-term needs through evaluation of the patient’s social and medical history.
* Develop a plan of care based upon the patient and providers of care clinical assessments, considering physical and psychosocial needs, the benefit plan and cost benefit analysis factors which impact the patient’s optimal recovery.
* Continuously evaluate the plan of care within the scope of case management practice based on the changing needs of the patient and monitor the quality of care and effectiveness of care being provided for all involved members of the inter disciplinary team.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and privacy standards, prompt payment/reimbursement and appeal process as indicated; coordinate the decision and documentation process; maintain a current and accurate database.
* Establish professional working relationships with all members of the interdisciplinary team and communicate case objectives to the appropriate involved parties.
* Act as a patient advocate understanding and identifying potential for complications, understanding methods for assessing the current and future physical and psychosocial characteristics of illnesses.
* Read, understand and apply principals of the American with Disabilities Act and understand federal legislation affecting individuals with disabilities.
* Be knowledgeable of assistive and adaptive equipment.
* Establish available support systems and be versed in methods of researching and interviewing community resources to assist the patient in achieving maximum psychological, social and physical recovery.
* Effectively communicate to the patient the available services and resources applicable to the patient’s immediate and future needs. Assist the patient in obtaining these services.
* Identify cases that would benefit from alternative care through assessment and evaluation of the patient’s needs, as well as available resources.
* Work closely with the payor, providers and all involved team members in evaluating the quality and cost effectiveness of services. Negotiate cost discounts when appropriate.
* Identify cases that would benefit from alternative levels of care and resources (i.e. rehabilitation facilities and home health care providers). Implement alternatives to existing care, considering quality of care and the patient’s current and ongoing needs.
* Understand case management concepts such as roles, philosophies, principles, liability and confidentiality issues. Apply these concepts in developing appropriate plan of care and goals based on the needs of the patient.
* Be knowledgeable in applying problem solving techniques to the case management process. Analyze and evaluate outcomes and implement alternatives when appropriate.
* Document the patient’s plan of care in a timely manner.
* Maintain professional status within the community through membership in professional organizations and/or participation in continuing education.
* Participate in Nova’s training and education committees as assigned. Provide input into support staff orientation and training as it relates to the Case Manager’s role.
* Provide support, guidance, and direction to support staff as indicated.
* Perform all assignments in a professional manner.
* Be knowledgeable of the scope of practice of their multi\-state licensure and practice accordingly.

Blackbird Health is clinician\-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in\-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, and New Jersey—and we're growing into new markets in 2026\.



At Blackbird, we take a whole\-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you'll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that's shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you're passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.



Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

**Position Summary**



Blackbird Health is expanding rapidly, and we are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and resilient **Clinical Operations Specialist** to join our Medical Services (MS) or Behavioral Health (BHD) Teams. This role is designed for a system\-minded professional who takes pride in supporting operational excellence. You will directly own the infrastructure of our day\-to\-day clinical services teams, mastering complex scheduling, architecting solutions for real\-time calendar changes, and managing non\-clinical patient touchpoints. You aren't just assisting a team; you are actively supporting the management of the clinical engine that ensures our patients get timely access to care and our providers experience a predictable, sustainable workday.



As a vital link between patients, providers, and leadership, you will manage day\-to\-day scheduling workflows, own the provider call\-out and PTO calendars, handle non\-clinical patient requests, and compile data reporting to help our leadership scale. This is a fully non\-clinical, high\-impact operational support role perfect for a self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and loves building order out of chaos. This is a fully remote role.


**What Makes You, You:**


* **You are a logistics puzzle master.** Managing complex calendars, sudden call\-outs, and shifting schedules doesn't stress you out—it energizes you.
* **You possess radical empathy and a calm demeanor.** Whether you are answering a busy medication refill line, routing a non\-clinical crisis, or handling a patient complaint, you listen deeply and remain completely unflustered.
* **You are fiercely organized.** You naturally track deadlines, monitor metrics, update data systems meticulously, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
* **You are an analytical helper.** You don't just collect data; you enjoy formatting and organizing it into clean, readable reports that make it easy for Directors and VPs to make decisions.
* **You thrive in an environment of autonomy.** You enjoy working in flat structures where you report directly to a Director, and you don't need constant hand\-holding to solve routine administrative problems.


**How You'll Make an Impact:**


* **Provider Attendance Ownership:** Manage day\-to\-day scheduling, rescheduling, and PTO tracking. Serve as the central air traffic control for unexpected provider call\-outs, ensuring immediate schedule coverage and system adjustments.
* **Patient Advocacy \& Issue Intake:** Act as the first line of defense for non\-clinical patient complaints, logging tracking data, and routing non\-clinical crises to appropriate leaders seamlessly.
* **Leadership Extension \& Reporting:** Free up significant bandwidth for your designated Medical Services Director by coordinating crucial meetings, managing IT requests, updating internal FAQs, and preparing operational reports.
* **System Flexibility:** Collaborate closely with your fellow MS Ops teammates to establish seamless shift, function, or specialty coverage as Blackbird's volume grows.


**The Basics You'll Need:**


* **Experience:** 2–4\+ years of experience in healthcare operations, medical scheduling, clinic coordination, or a high\-volume virtual operations support environment.
* **Tech Savvy:** High comfort level with Electronic Medical Records (EMR) software (Athena preferred), communication tools (Slack/Teams), and spreadsheet/data management.
* **Schedule Flexibility:** Ability to support a flexible operational schedule, including evening, weekend, and rotating on\-call coverage to ensure our providers and patients are always supported.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to navigate sensitive healthcare conversations with professionalism.
* **Background Check:** Successful completion of standard healthcare background check and credentialing verification.


Blackbird Health is made up of intelligent, humble, compassionate, and hardworking people. Joining our ranks means you'll have an automatic network to turn to for operational best practices, professional development, and opportunities to share your expertise.

**Join us!**



To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child's brain, body, and behavior work together.



"It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this\-from testing to therapy to med management (and more)\-all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone."


**Fostering an inclusive environment:**



Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. **Culture:**  Join a supportive and inclusive work environment where collaboration, respect, and open communication are at the core of everything we do.
  
  

**Competitive Compensation:**  We offer a highly competitive compensation and total rewards package, ensuring that your hard work and dedication are recognized and rewarded accordingly.

**Opportunity:**  A continuous focus on professional development with many opportunities for training and career growth.
  
  

**Safety Focused:**  We care about you and have developed a 24/7 safety mindset that is showcased throughout every facet of the organization.
  
  

We’re looking for a Program Manager of Talent Performance \& Experience to enable and support a workplace where every employee feels connected, empowered, and inspired to perform at their best. In this role, you’ll be the owner of programs that make work meaningful—managing projects that align individual goals with organizational priorities while fostering a culture of inclusion, growth, and recognition. You’ll build and own programs to monitor, support, and embed our Superior culture throughout a newly integrated North American organization. Areas of responsibility will include employee experience initiatives such as employee listening and recognition.
  
  

**What you’ll do:**  

* Program Management: Design, implement, and manage programs and processes to improve the employee experience, including project management, vendor management, content creation, communications, and program analytics.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with relevant stakeholders to ensure the simplicity, relevancy, and value of programs, and provide guidance to HRBPs to support successful adoption.
* Recognition: Manage our internal recognition platform and lead recognition initiatives, including the creation of formal award programs tied to our new values. Evolve recognition to act as a change enabler in reinforcing new ways of working.
* Culture: Execute on our employee experience strategy with programs and initiatives to connect our employees to our culture at key moments throughout the employee lifecycle. Support our HR, safety, marketing, and communication partners in embedding our values into our organization.
* Employee Listening: Support the senior manager in executing our employee listening strategy. Manage our approach to how we listen to, learn from, and act on employee feedback.
* Technology Enablement: Leverage technology and AI to optimize performance and engagement programs.
* Compliance: Ensure adherence to employment laws and organizational policies.


**What you bring:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Human Resources, Industrial Organizational Psychology, or related field required. Master’s preferred.
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in talent management, organizational development, or related HR functions.
* Working knowledge of different philosophies around talent management and employee experience, and a practical approach to implementing best practices.
* Experience in multi\-site and multi\-national organizations preferred.
* Legal Authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this job opening.


**Work Location:** Fully remote candidates will be considered for the right fit.
  
  

**Pay Transparency:**  

The expected annual salary range for this role is $80,000\-$100,000 a year. This position is also eligible for an annual incentive program. Please note the compensation information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, geographical location, as well as market and business considerations
  
  

Here at Superior Plus Propane, we are an equal opportunity employer committed to the inclusion and accommodation of all individuals, we welcome all qualified candidates to apply. If you have an accommodation need during the recruitment \& selection process, we encourage you to connect with us at sppcareers@superiorpluspropane.com to let us know how we can enhance your experience.

jobs.title: Field Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Field Implementation Manager**


**Location:** Remote (U.S. and near a major airport) / Travel onsite to dealerships is required.


**Schedule:** Standard business hours. Approximately 3 weeks per month of onsite travel across the U.S. and Canada.


**About Numa**



Numa is building the platform to power AI\-native dealerships, rearchitecting automotive service and sales with advanced AI agents that automate customer interactions, streamline operations, and reimagine how dealerships work. Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions—from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times that drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).


**The Role**



We're looking for a Field Implementation Manager to bring Numa's AI\-powered platform to life inside dealerships across North America. In this role, you will spend most of your time on\-site launching Numa; training staff, solving real\-time challenges, and setting teams up for long\-term success.



This isn't a behind the desk job. You'll be part trainer, part problem\-solver, part motivator; showing dealership teams the value of using Numa every day and making sure our solution sticks. You'll also serve as the bridge between the field and our internal teams, sharing insights that shape how we scale onboarding and rollout.



The ideal candidate thrives in fast\-paced environments, builds trust quickly, and loves being in the field. You take initiative, adapt to any audience, and are energized by the challenge of driving successful go\-lives without heavy direction.


**What You'll Do**


* Lead onsite go\-lives and ensure smooth, successful launches
* Train dealership staff across roles with clear, hands\-on, and engaging sessions
* Partner with dealership leaders to highlight the long\-term business value of Numa
* Document launch outcomes and transition accounts to our Performance Architect team
* Share field insights with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to improve onboarding and customer experience
* Travel onsite to dealerships regularly to drive engagement and adoption


**What You Bring**


* 1\+ years of customer\-facing experience in training, onboarding, service, or support
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to command a room and adapt to any audience
* Tech\-savvy, with the ability to quickly learn new systems and tools
* High emotional intelligence, with the ability to build trust quickly in fast\-paced environments
* Excitement to travel \~3 weeks per month across the U.S. and Canada (must live near a major airport)


**Nice To Have**


* Experience with SaaS, automotive, or phone systems
* Background in field\-based training, deployment, or customer onboarding
* Familiarity with dealership operations or service department workflows
* Experience supporting product go\-lives or rollouts in a high\-growth environment
* Comfort using AI tools to streamline training, documentation, or workflows
* Bilingual (English/French or English/Spanish) for broader coverage across the U.S. and Canada


**What Success Looks Like**


* Deliver smooth, successful go\-lives that set dealership teams up for long\-term adoption
* Build trusted relationships with dealership staff and leadership during launch
* Ensure Numa becomes part of dealership teams' daily workflow
* Enable seamless account transitions to the Performance Architect team
* Consistently surface field insights that improve how Numa scales onboarding and rollout


**Why Join Numa**


* We believe in everyone's growth.
* Be part of an industry leader named the \#1 fastest\-growing AI Automotive company by Inc. 5000\.
* Represent category\-defining AI technology that is transforming the automotive industry.
* Join a high\-growth organization with significant opportunities for career advancement.


**Compensation \& Benefits**


* Base Salary: $78,000 USD
* Equity Package
* Flexible PTO
* Health, dental, and vision benefits
* 401(k) plan


At Numa, you'll have the chance to represent game\-changing technology in an industry that's ready for innovation. If you love being in the field, thrive on solving problems in real time, and want to make an impact at a high\-growth company, we'd love to hear from you.

**About Us**
============

**Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.**

**Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:**

* **Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority\- and woman\-owned enterprise in the U.S.**
* **Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.**
* **Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.**
* **World\-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.**

**Job Summary**
===============

The PubSec Microsoft Account Manager is responsible for driving customer retention and growth by identifying client pain points and developing tailored solutions, while maintaining regular communication to align sales and supply chain forecasts. This role involves hosting business reviews, engaging internal and external resources to meet customer needs, and acting as the primary liaison between customers, sales, and internal departments. Additionally, the Account Manager is tasked with providing exceptional customer service, managing CRM activities, and supporting major initiative campaigns to enhance technology deployment and utilization.

* Drive retention and growth by identifying customers’ pain points and developing end\-to\-end solutions.

* Engage Account Executives and other resources to demonstrate capabilities and address customer needs.

* Create, track, and update activities in the CRM system.
* Act as a central point of contact between customers, outside sales, and internal departments.

**Behaviors and Competencies**

* Time Management: Can generally use time effectively and is working towards improving task prioritization and deadline management.
* Organization: Can prioritize daily tasks, manage personal workflow, and utilize basic tools to keep track of responsibilities.
* Planning: Can identify opportunities for improvement, propose plans, and organize resources without explicit instructions.
* Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information, and can adapt communication style to the audience.

* Adaptability: Can adjust to changes in the work environment, manage multiple tasks, and effectively handle uncertainty.

* Ability to develop detailed Statements of Work (SOWs) and drive revenue growth through professional services engagements \- Intermediate
* The ability to effectively utilize applications like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook to enhance productivity and perform various tasks efficiently \- Intermediate
* Proficiency in overseeing and coordinating multiple related projects, ensuring they align with organizational goals and deliver intended benefits on time and within budget \- Intermediate
* Proficiency in utilizing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software to manage and analyze customer interactions and data throughout the customer lifecycle, improving customer service, retention, and sales growth \- Intermediate

* Proficiency in selling information technology products and services on a global scale, including understanding diverse market dynamics, managing international client relationships, and navigating complex sales processes across different regions \- Intermediate

* Advanced sales EOM sales certification preferred (i.e. Microsoft, Dell, HP, Cisco, AWS, Lenovo, etc.)

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $90,000 \- $130,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About By the Pixel**

By the Pixel is an established digital agency headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with remote team members across the U.S. Since 2010, we've designed and built high\-end web applications for clients in healthcare, automotive sales, research and development, hospitality, the nonprofit sector, and more.

We support our clients end\-to\-end: strategy, design, custom development, hosting, tiered production support, SEO, paid advertising, and content marketing. Most of what we build is engineered from scratch, because a one\-size\-fits\-all bundle rarely fits.

**How this role fits**

The Account Manager is responsible for growing the agency's work with its existing clients, building and maintaining long\-term client relationships, and managing the commercial side of each account, including contracts and invoicing. They also serve as the intake point for inbound leads, running first contact and discovery before new work is scoped.

**What you'll own**

**Client Relationship Management**

* Owns the long\-term relationship with each client, independent of any single project's lifecycle.
* Builds trust with decision\-makers and budget holders through a consistent cadence of meetings and check\-ins that sit above project status.
* Develops and maintains a deep understanding of each client's goals, challenges, budget cycles, and industry context.
* Serves as the escalation point for the account, handling client concerns and difficult conversations directly, responding promptly when the Project Manager raises something they cannot resolve on their own, and bringing in leadership when needed.
* Monitors account health and satisfaction, acting on early signs of friction or disengagement before they become churn risks.
* Leads client communication whenever a conversation is commercial, contractual, or sensitive.
* Attends client demos led by the relevant department lead and takes over when the conversation turns commercial.
* Keeps the company’s CRM up to date across their accounts and leads, logging contacts, deals, interactions, decisions, and commitments.

**New Business \& Lead Intake**

* Serves as intake for new inbound leads, owning the initial contact and qualifying fit against the agency's services, capacity, and ideal client profile.
* Leads pre\-sale discovery, surfacing the prospect's goals, constraints, timelines, budget range, and decision\-making process before any scoping begins.
* Translates discovery findings into a clear internal brief that the project team can scope and estimate, and that the Proposal \& Business Development Manager can use to build the proposal.
* Keeps deals moving toward a decision in HubSpot, maintaining stage, source, value, and next steps to keep pipeline reporting accurate, and follows up with clients on proposals awaiting a decision.
* Attends pipeline review meetings, bringing the status of open proposals and prospective work across their accounts.
* Watches pipeline trends worth acting on across their accounts, including where leads come from, which types convert, and where they stall, and brings what they learn to the pipeline review.
* Contributes account context, references, and client results to the proposal asset library, so the Proposal \& Business Development Manager and anyone pursuing new work can draw on them.

**Proposals, Contracts \& Commercial Agreements**
