jobs.title: Document Specialist & Training Specialist (Document Remediation)
jobs.description:
At Team Carney, we believe that true performance acceleration happens at the intersection of innovative learning and deep strategic expertise. Since 1994, our mission has been to provide top\-tier training, learning, and human capital solutions that empower Federal Government agencies to meet their critical mandates. We are seeking a dedicated Document Specialist \& Training Specialist (Document Remediation) to support our federal client.


This position is contingent on contract award.

### **Work Schedule and Location**

* **Employment Status:** Full\-Time
* **Location:** This position is fully remote within the U.S.

**Who You Are \& What You’ll Do**
---------------------------------


The Document Specialist \& Training Specialist (Document Remediation) will combine hands\-on technical document accessibility remediation with instructor\-led training delivery to ensure federal digital content meets strict Section 508 accessibility standards.


In this full\-time role, you will perform technical evaluation and remediation of electronic documents and forms across Microsoft Office and Adobe PDF formats using tests endorsed by the Federal CIO Council Community of Practice. In addition to direct remediation work, you will design, create, and facilitate instructor\-led training sessions to educate government personnel on document accessibility standards, evaluation methodologies, and remediation techniques. You will also assist the government in making multimedia content fully Section 508 compliant.

**What You Bring to the Table \- Requirements**
-----------------------------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
* **Experience:**


	+ 2\+ years of dedicated experience evaluating and remediating electronic documents and forms (including Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe PDF) for Section 508 compliance.
	+ Proven experience creating and delivering instructor\-led training materials and conducting training sessions on document accessibility.
* **Standards Knowledge:** Broad knowledge and practical understanding of Accessibility Tests for Documents endorsed by the Federal CIO Council Community of Practice and Revised Section 508 Standards.
* **Core Capabilities:**


	+ **Document \& Form Remediation:** Skilled in evaluating, remediating, and validating complex electronic documents, PDFs, fillable forms, spreadsheets, and presentations to ensure full accessibility.
	+ **Instructional Delivery:** Demonstrated ability to provide clear verbal and written instruction and conduct engaging instructor\-led training on document accessibility and remediation techniques.
	+ **Multimedia Compliance:** Ability to assist the government in making multimedia content, digital assets, and video materials Section 508 compliant (including captioning, transcripts, and audio descriptions).
	+ **Communication:** Excellent technical writing and oral presentation skills to translate accessibility standards into clear, actionable training content for government personnel.

**Why Join Team Carney?**
-------------------------


When you join Team Carney, you join a legacy of excellence. We focus on our people because when we make a positive impact on the lives of our employees, they are able to make a positive impact on our clients. We offer a full suite of competitive benefits, including:

* **Health \& Wellness:** Multiple medical, dental, and vision insurance options (BCBS CareFirst), health spending accounts (HSA), and flexible spending accounts (FSA).
* **Financial Security:** 401(k) retirement plan with company match, plus Carney\-paid life and disability insurance.
* **Work\-Life Harmony:** Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), 11 paid holidays, and 6 weeks of paid parental leave.
* **Professional \& Personal Growth:** Annual tuition assistance (up to $5,000\) and student loan repayment.
* **Get Out and Learn:** Up to $200 annually to learn almost anything (from pottery to coding!).
* **Get Out and Run:** Up to $200 annually to participate in fitness and active lifestyle events.
* **Continuous Development:** Ad hoc training and ongoing professional development access.

The BA will play an important role in discovery, requirements gathering and helping determine how acquired business capabilities and processes will integrate into the existing organization.

* Knowledge of products such as accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, disability and group life
* Strong requirements gathering, discovery and process\-mapping experience
* Experience working between business stakeholders and technical teams
* Understanding of insurance policy, billing, claims, enrollment or product administration processes

* Experience with data mapping, reconciliation and UAT
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

Nice to Have

* Experience working for an insurance carrier
* M\&A or book\-of\-business conversion experience

jobs.title: CRM & Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**About brightfin**



brightfin is the AI\-powered Financial Management Intelligence Platform for Enterprise IT, helping Fortune 500 and mid\-market CFOs, CIOs, and IT finance teams understand, govern, and optimize technology spend across telecom, FinOps, and IT asset management. Our customers include large healthcare systems, financial institutions, and global enterprises — organizations where data security and trust are non\-negotiable.

  

**Job summary**



brightfin's sales team is growing, and the systems and processes behind it need to grow with it. The CRM \& Ops Analyst owns the day\-to\-day health of brightfin's CRM (Zoho) and the operational backbone that supports the sales team: clean data, reliable reporting, and processes that hold up as headcount increases. You'll be the person sales, sales leadership, and cross\-functional partners in marketing, finance, and customer success turn to when they need the pipeline data or process to be right the first time.

  

This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role at a company still building its sales operations function from a small base — expect to work close to the details, not just the strategy.

 **Essential functions**

 ***CRM administration (Zoho)***


* Own day\-to\-day administration of Zoho CRM: user and role management, workflow and automation configuration, field and layout changes, and third\-party integrations.
* Creation of new automations to support increased deal volume as the company scales.
* Maintain data integrity — deduplication, validation rules, and routine audits — so pipeline, account, and contact data can be trusted.
* Document CRM configuration and processes so they're repeatable as the sales team scales.


***Sales operations support***


* Support pipeline management, forecasting, and quota tracking for the sales team.
* Support the deal desk approval process — tracking deal terms and approvals and flagging exceptions for Sales Operations and Finance.
* Manage lead routing and territory assignment rules in partnership with marketing and sales leadership.
* Execute post\-sale deals processing for handoff to finance and customer success.
* Use of AI tools to increase sales and marketing efficiency.


***Reporting and analytics***


* Build and maintain dashboards and reports covering pipeline health, funnel conversion, quota attainment, and other core sales KPIs.
* Prepare recurring reporting for sales leadership, and ad hoc analysis to support board and leadership\-level questions.
* Identify trends and process breakdowns in the data and bring them to Sales Operations leadership with a recommendation, not just a chart.


***Cross\-functional coordination***


* Partner with marketing on lead handoff and campaign tracking inside the CRM.
* Partner with customer success and finance on renewal and account data continuity as deals move from sales to post\-sale.
* Serve as a point of contact for sales reps on day\-to\-day CRM questions and requests.
* Cross\-train with Sales Operations on order form \& contract generation, board \& leadership collateral preparation, sales onboarding, and sales training.

  


**Qualifications**


**Experience**


* 2–4 years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, CRM administration, or a business/data analyst role.
* Hands\-on CRM administration experience — Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot, or a comparable platform. Zoho experience is a strong plus given brightfin's stack.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS environment preferred.
* Experience with sales onboarding \& training a plus.


**Skills and competencies**


* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfortable building dashboards in tools like Zoho Analytics, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
* High attention to detail and a strong bias toward clean, trustworthy data.
* Process\-minded — able to document and improve a workflow, not just execute it.
* Comfortable in a small, fast\-moving operations team where the function is still being built.
* SQL/lead flow proficiency is a plus, not a requirement.


**Education**


* Bachelor's degree in business, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.


**Preferred qualifications**


* Direct Zoho CRM administration experience.
* Experience supporting a deal desk or deal\-approval workflow.
* Experience at a PE\-backed or growth\-stage SaaS company.
* Familiarity with IT spend management, FinOps, TEM, or ITFM, or the ServiceNow ecosystem.

  


**Compensation \& Benefits:**

  

* brightfin offers a comprehensive health, dental and vision benefits package.
* Paid time off. We strongly believe in work\-life balance and taking time for yourself.
* 401K with employer match
* Compensation Range: $60,000 \- $70,000 / Year

**Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers**

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting\-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.


**Your role at a glance**

The Business Analyst is a seasoned subject matter expert responsible for enabling operational excellence through scalable tooling platforms and actionable analytics. This role supports global construction initiatives by integrating monitoring, automation, and reporting tools, and partnering with cross\-functional teams to align tooling capabilities with strategic goals. The analyst drives innovation in data architecture and visualization to support continuous improvement and transparency.
**What we are looking for**

The Business Analyst is a seasoned subject matter expert responsible for enabling operational excellence through scalable tooling platforms and actionable analytics. This role supports global construction initiatives by integrating monitoring, automation, and reporting tools, and partnering with cross\-functional teams to align tooling capabilities with strategic goals. The analyst drives innovation in data architecture and visualization to support continuous improvement and transparency.


Key responsibilities


Core Business Analysis \& Strategic Alignment


* Act as a bridge between business needs and technology solutions, translating complex requirements into actionable deliverables.
* Analyze, transform, and resolve business problems through data\-driven and technology\-enabled solutions.
* Work with internal stakeholders to determine business requirements using best‑practice methodologies.
* Deliver business projects in alignment with sponsor expectations and enterprise architecture standards.
* Partner with cross‑functional teams to ensure tooling, data, and analytics capabilities support evolving strategic goals.

Data Foundations \& Performance Measurement


* Build and maintain foundational datasets reflecting infrastructure usage, efficiency, and scalability.
* Define and operationalize KPI frameworks and success metrics to monitor global construction and infrastructure performance.
* Establish source‑of‑truth dashboards and reporting that guide infrastructure, investment, and product decisions.
Define, track, and continually refine metrics that evaluate model effectiveness and drive performance improvement.  
* 

Analytics \& Strategic Impact


* Lead end‑to‑end analytics initiatives to inform infrastructure strategy, investment prioritization, and operational excellence.
* Conduct scenario modeling, forecasting, and sensitivity analyses to identify risks, gaps, and growth opportunities.
* Apply advanced statistical and analytical methods to solve complex problems using large structured and unstructured datasets.
* Translate complex analytical outputs into clear, explainable insights for executive and non‑technical stakeholders.

Data Products, Automation \& Tooling


* Develop and maintain scalable tooling platforms that support operational excellence across global construction.
* Identify, design, and automate recurring reporting, analytics workflows, and data processes using scalable data products and agentic solutions.
* Integrate monitoring, automation, and reporting tools to enhance visibility, performance, and compliance.
* Deliver dynamic, executive‑ready dashboards that enable real‑time KPI tracking and decision‑making.

Machine Learning, AI \& Advanced Modeling


* Oversee the development, testing, and deployment of machine learning and AI models used for analytics, prediction, personalization, and optimization.
* Ensure robust performance measurement, drift monitoring, and continuous improvement of deployed models.
* Drive innovation in model development, data architecture, and visualization to support transparency and continuous improvement.

Leadership, Influence \& Capability Building


* Elevate analytics maturity by mentoring team members and cross‑functional partners.
* Promote best practices in data governance, experimentation, model measurement, and performance management.
* Champion high‑quality documentation including requirements, test cases, workflows, and user guides.
* Foster stakeholder alignment through clear communication, structured problem‑solving, and results‑oriented delivery.

KNOWLEDGE \& ATTRIBUTES


* Proven ability to contribute to performance strategies that drive operational excellence and business outcomes.
* Extended knowledge of data center facilities, infrastructure, best practices, and industry standards
* Extended communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration, stakeholder management, and reporting.
* Extended problem\-solving and analytical abilities to address complex challenges.
* Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with industry trends and best practices.
* Good financial acumen, budgeting skills, and seasoned understanding of business practices and processes.
* Excellent team player with a strong service orientation and meticulous attention to detail while working under pressure.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Knowledge of process mapping and project management methodologies.
* Strong analytical skills to convert business requirements into operational deliverables.
* Proficiency in documentation including functional requirements, test cases, and user guides.

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. **Job Description:**

**Staff Product Operations Manager**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a **Staff** **Product Operations Manager** to build and operate the processes that connect product strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and portfolio decision\-making across a multi\-product R\&D organization.


This role will partner closely with Product Management, R\&D Operations, Program Management, Engineering, and Finance to create a consistent and scalable approach for product management and R\&D priorities.


The Staff Product Operations Manager will provide the structure, analytics, and governance needed to help leadership make informed tradeoffs across products while enabling Product Managers to remain focused on customers, markets, product strategy, and product outcomes.  



**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with Product Managers to create governance around product strategies, value propositions, target markets, and strategic objectives
* Integrate individual product strategies and roadmaps into a consolidated enterprise product portfolio view.
* Develop clear executive\-level views of priorities, roadmap changes, portfolio performance, dependencies, tradeoffs and coordinate regular product portfolio reviews.
* Facilitate cross\-product prioritization and develop tradeoff scenarios for leadership.
* Partner with R\&D Program Management and Engineering to identify capacity and resource conflicts created by product priorities.
* Incorporate financial analysis, ROI, NPV, sensitivity analysis, and investment requirements into portfolio decisions. Ensure product, commercial, engineering, financial, and execution inputs are available for major portfolio decisions.
* Establish common product and portfolio KPI standards.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering or related field; MBA preferred but not required.
* 12\+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Operations or related functions.
* Experience working in global complex product\-development environments; hardware, industrial technology, or engineering\-intensive industries preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with product roadmaps, portfolio prioritization, business cases, and executive governance.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to structure complex portfolio decisions and tradeoffs.
* Experience developing scalable processes, dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting.
* Strong cross\-functional leadership and communication skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Ability to translate between product, engineering, financial, and executive stakeholders.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A clear and integrated enterprise view of product strategy and roadmaps.
* Consistent prioritization and business\-case standards across product teams.
* Leadership has clear visibility into portfolio tradeoffs before making investment and resource decisions.
* Product demand is translated into clear, prioritized inputs for R\&D portfolio planning.
* Resource and roadmap conflicts are identified earlier.

* **Own the company's Confluence space,** including governance conventions, version control standards, and ensuring the latest board decks, narratives, scorecards, and executive communications

new_jobs.title: Compliance & Regulatory Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Candiid Labs is an engineering studio operating a portfolio of production platforms in regulated industries. Our flagship product, Connexx, is a HIPAA\-compliant clinical platform serving behavioral health, developmental disability services, home health, and general practice providers. We are early\-stage, growing quickly, and currently onboarding enterprise customers in multiple states.

Our team is small, senior, and distributed. We hire people who can own their function without daily supervision, who write clearly, and who are honest about what they know and don't know.

Why We Are Hiring for This Role

As Connexx grows across new states, the compliance and regulatory work required to operate legitimately in each jurisdiction is expanding faster than the founder can personally manage. HIPAA program maintenance, state\-specific behavioral health regulations, payer\-specific compliance requirements, Business Associate Agreement reviews, subprocessor compliance oversight, and compliance\-related customer questions have grown into a full function that needs a dedicated owner.

You will be the first dedicated compliance hire at Candiid Labs. This is substantive work with real ownership. You will not be doing generic administrative tasks. You will be running the compliance function.

What You Will Own

HIPAA Program Management

* Maintain our written HIPAA policies and procedures across Privacy Rule, Security Rule, and Breach Notification Rule requirements
* Coordinate annual HIPAA Security Risk Assessment updates
* Manage workforce HIPAA training tracking and documentation
* Own the compliance evidence library for customer due diligence responses

Business Associate Agreement (BAA) Management

* Review incoming BAAs from customers, redlining against our standard positions
* Maintain BAAs with all subprocessors (cloud providers, AI providers, communication vendors)
* Maintain the master BAA registry with expiration and renewal tracking

State\-Specific Regulatory Work

* Build and maintain compliance maps for each state we operate in
* Own the research and documentation for each new state entry as Connexx expands
* Track and interpret changes to state behavioral health, home health, and developmental disability regulations affecting our customers

Payer\-Specific Compliance

* Document billing rules, encounter data requirements, and audit expectations for each Medicaid Managed Care Organization our customers work with
* Maintain compliance references for state\-specific data submission systems

Customer\-Facing Compliance Artifacts

* Draft compliance sections of proposals, capabilities briefings, and enterprise sales materials
* Respond to customer security questionnaires
* Prepare responses to auditor requests

Subprocessor Oversight

* Maintain the list of subprocessors touching customer data
* Verify each subprocessor has current BAA, active security posture, and documented compliance status
* Onboard new subprocessors through a compliance review before engagement

Breach Preparedness and Response

* Maintain the incident response plan and breach notification procedures
* Coordinate breach response if an incident occurs (final breach determination and notification decisions escalate to CEO and external counsel)

Documentation and Evidence

* Maintain the compliance evidence library
* Prepare materials for customer audits, SOC 2 readiness work, and future federal engagements

What We Are Looking For

Required

* 4\+ years of experience in healthcare compliance, healthcare regulatory work, or a closely related function
* Prior direct exposure to US healthcare compliance environments (through work at a healthcare organization, healthcare vendor, consulting firm serving health systems, remote employment with a healthcare company, or similar path)
* Working knowledge of HIPAA (Privacy Rule, Security Rule, Breach Notification Rule) that goes beyond having read the regulations. You should be able to explain how HIPAA applies to specific operational situations.
* Strong written English, particularly the ability to draft compliance policies, BAA redlines, and customer\-facing compliance responses that read professionally to enterprise buyers
* Ability to work independently and own a function without daily supervision
* Comfort with US Eastern time zone

Strongly Preferred

* Prior experience with behavioral health, mental health, or developmental disability services compliance specifically
* Familiarity with state\-level healthcare regulations
* Experience reviewing and negotiating BAAs
* Familiarity with 42 CFR Part 2 (federal substance use disorder record confidentiality)
* Prior work with health plan or Medicaid Managed Care Organization compliance requirements
* SOC 2 readiness or audit experience

Nice to Have

* Certifications: CHC (Certified in Healthcare Compliance), CHPC (Certified in Healthcare Privacy Compliance), CIPP/US, HCCA membership
* Experience with AI\-specific healthcare compliance (LLM providers, PHI in AI contexts)

What We Are Not Looking For

* Generic HR or administrative professionals looking to move into compliance
* Compliance generalists without healthcare\-specific experience
* Candidates who overstate their experience. We will verify through interviews and references. Please represent your background accurately. We would rather hire someone at a slightly junior level who represents themselves honestly than someone at a senior level who cannot answer specific questions in interview.

Compensation and Engagement Terms

* Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. We will discuss compensation openly during the interview process.
* Annual compensation review with performance\-based increases
* Direct working relationship with the founder and CEO of a growing company; substantial career development opportunity
* Path to expanded role and scope as Connexx grows

How to Apply

Send an email to: janet@candiid.io
